cvars.name: _campaign_testrun
cvars.description: To verify the campaign file, set this to 1, then start the first campaign level from the menu. If you end up in the menu again, it's good, if you get a QC crash, it's bad.

cvars.name: _cl_color
cvars.description: internal storage cvar for current player colors (changed by color command)

cvars.name: _cl_name
cvars.description: internal storage cvar for current player name (changed by name command)

cvars.name: _cl_playermodel
cvars.description: internal storage cvar for current player model in Nexuiz/Xonotic (changed by playermodel command)

cvars.name: _cl_playerskin
cvars.description: internal storage cvar for current player skin in Nexuiz/Xonotic (changed by playerskin command)

cvars.name: _cl_pmodel
cvars.description: internal storage cvar for current player model number in nehahra (changed by pmodel command)

cvars.name: _cl_rate
cvars.description: internal storage cvar for current rate (changed by rate command)

cvars.name: _cl_rate_burstsize
cvars.description: internal storage cvar for current rate control burst size (changed by rate_burstsize command)

cvars.name: _endmatch
cvars.description: if set to 1 ends the match immediately; use it instead of timelimit -1 (deprecated)

cvars.name: _hud_panel_quickmenu_file_from_server
cvars.description: reserved cvar set by the server with a custom server quickmenu file that appears in the default quickmenu

cvars.name: _hud_panelorder
cvars.description: contains order in which panels are to be drawn

cvars.name: _hud_showbinds_reload
cvars.description: set it to 1 to reload binds if you changed any. It is reset to 0 automatically

cvars.name: _menu_credits_export
cvars.description: set to 1 and restart the menu to export credits to credits.txt (menu will automatically reset to 0)

cvars.name: _menu_initialized
cvars.description: is 0 on first menu loading, 1 later

cvars.name: _teams_available
cvars.description: internal cvar, value is synced from the server to reflect currently available teams to join

cvars.name: accuracy_color_levels
cvars.description: accuracy values at which a specified color (accuracy_color<X>) will be used. If your accuracy is between 2 of these values then a mix of the Xth and X+1th colors will be used. You can specify up to 10 values, in increasing order

cvars.name: bot_ai_aimskill_blendrate
cvars.description: How much correction will be applied to the aiming angle

cvars.name: bot_ai_aimskill_fixedrate
cvars.description: Distance based scale from which correction will be applied to the aiming angle

cvars.name: bot_ai_aimskill_mouse
cvars.description: How much of the aiming filters are applied

cvars.name: bot_ai_aimskill_offset
cvars.description: Amount of error induced to the bots aim

cvars.name: bot_ai_aimskill_order_mix_1st
cvars.description: Amount of the 1st filter output to apply to the aiming angle

cvars.name: bot_ai_aimskill_order_mix_2nd
cvars.description: Amount of the 2nd filter output to apply to the aiming angle

cvars.name: bot_ai_aimskill_order_mix_3th
cvars.description: Amount of the 3th filter output to apply to the aiming angle

cvars.name: bot_ai_aimskill_order_mix_4th
cvars.description: Amount of the 4th filter output to apply to the aiming angle

cvars.name: bot_ai_aimskill_order_mix_5th
cvars.description: Amount of the 5th filter output to apply to the aiming angle

cvars.name: bot_ai_aimskill_think
cvars.description: Aiming velocity. Use values below 1 for slower aiming

cvars.name: bot_ai_bunnyhop_dir_deviation_max
cvars.description: bunnyhop if speed - direction deviation is <= this amount

cvars.name: bot_ai_bunnyhop_downward_pitch_max
cvars.description: bunnyhop if downard pitch towards the next waypoint is <= this amount

cvars.name: bot_ai_bunnyhop_skilloffset
cvars.description: Bots with skill equal or greater than this value will perform the "bunnyhop" technique

cvars.name: bot_ai_bunnyhop_turn_angle_max
cvars.description: bunnyhop if next turn angle is <= this amount at walk speed (sv_maxspeed)

cvars.name: bot_ai_bunnyhop_turn_angle_min
cvars.description: bunnyhop regardless of speed if next turn angle is <= this amount

cvars.name: bot_ai_bunnyhop_turn_angle_reduction
cvars.description: linearly reduce max turn angle by this amount when speed increases by sv_maxspeed

cvars.name: bot_ai_chooseweaponinterval
cvars.description: How often the best weapon according to the situation will be chosen

cvars.name: bot_ai_custom_weapon_priority_close
cvars.default: vaporizer oknex vortex okshotgun shotgun shockwave okmachinegun machinegun arc hlac tuba seeker hagar crylink mortar electro devastator blaster fireball rifle minelayer
cvars.description: Desired weapons for close distances ordered by priority

cvars.name: bot_ai_custom_weapon_priority_distances
cvars.description: Define close and far distances in any order. Based on the distance to the enemy bots will choose different weapons

cvars.name: bot_ai_custom_weapon_priority_far
cvars.default: vaporizer oknex vortex rifle electro devastator mortar hagar hlac crylink blaster okmachinegun machinegun fireball seeker okshotgun shotgun shockwave tuba minelayer
cvars.description: Desired weapons for far distances ordered by priority

cvars.name: bot_ai_custom_weapon_priority_mid
cvars.default: vaporizer devastator oknex vortex fireball seeker mortar electro okmachinegun machinegun arc crylink hlac hagar okshotgun shotgun shockwave blaster rifle tuba minelayer
cvars.description: Desired weapons for middle distances ordered by priority

cvars.name: bot_ai_dangerdetectioninterval
cvars.description: How often scan for waypoints with dangers near

cvars.name: bot_ai_dangerdetectionupdates
cvars.description: How many waypoints will be considered for danger detection

cvars.name: bot_ai_dodgeupdateinterval
cvars.description: How often scan for items to dodge. Currently not in use.

cvars.name: bot_ai_enemydetectioninterval
cvars.description: How often bots try to pick a new target if no suitable target is found

cvars.name: bot_ai_enemydetectioninterval_stickingtoenemy
cvars.description: How often bots try to pick a new target while targetting an enemy

cvars.name: bot_ai_enemydetectionradius
cvars.description: How far bots can see enemies

cvars.name: bot_ai_friends_aware_pickup_radius
cvars.description: Bots will not pickup items if a team mate is this distance near the item

cvars.name: bot_ai_ignoregoal_timeout
cvars.description: Ignore goals making bots to get stuck in front of a wall for N seconds

cvars.name: bot_ai_keyboard_distance
cvars.description: Keyboard emulation is disabled after this distance to the goal

cvars.name: bot_ai_navigation_jetpack
cvars.description: Enable bots to navigate maps using the jetpack

cvars.name: bot_ai_navigation_jetpack_mindistance
cvars.description: Bots will try fly to objects located farther than this distance

cvars.name: bot_ai_strategyinterval
cvars.description: How often a new objective is chosen

cvars.name: bot_ai_strategyinterval_movingtarget
cvars.description: How often a new objective is chosen when current objective can move

cvars.name: bot_ai_thinkinterval
cvars.description: Frame rate at which bots update their navigation and aiming, scales by skill

cvars.name: bot_ai_timeitems
cvars.description: allow skilled bots to run to important items a little time before respawning

cvars.name: bot_ai_timeitems_minrespawndelay
cvars.description: bots run to items with this minimum respawn delay before respawning

cvars.name: bot_ai_weapon_combo
cvars.description: Enable bots to do weapon combos

cvars.name: bot_ai_weapon_combo_threshold
cvars.description: Try to make a combo N seconds after the last attack

cvars.name: bot_config_file
cvars.description: Name and path of the bot configuration file

cvars.name: bot_debug_goalstack
cvars.description: Visualize the current path that each bot is following. Use with as few bots as possible.

cvars.name: bot_debug_tracewalk
cvars.description: Enable visual indicators for short-term navigation. Green: Goal Reached / Yellow: Obstacle found / Red: Unsolvable obstacle found

cvars.name: bot_ignore_bots
cvars.description: When set, bots don't shoot at other bots

cvars.name: bot_join_empty
cvars.description: When set, bots also play if no player has joined the server

cvars.name: bot_nofire
cvars.description: When set, bots never fire. Mainly for testing in g_waypointeditor mode

cvars.name: bot_prefix
cvars.description: Prefix in front of the bot names

cvars.name: bot_sound_monopoly
cvars.description: when enabled, only bots can make any noise

cvars.name: bot_typefrag
cvars.description: Allow bots to shoot players while they're typing

cvars.name: bot_usemodelnames
cvars.description: Use player model names for bot names

cvars.name: bot_vs_human
cvars.description: Bots and humans play in different teams when set. positive values to make an all-bot blue team, set to negative values to make an all-bot red team, the absolute value is the ratio bots vs humans (1 for equal count). Changes will be correctly applied only from the next game

cvars.name: bot_wander_enable
cvars.description: Have bots wander around if they are unable to reach any useful goal. Disable only for debugging purposes.

cvars.name: camera_chase_smoothly
cvars.description: Attenuate player movements (only in chase mode)

cvars.name: camera_enable
cvars.description: Enables the camera for demo playback

cvars.name: camera_forward_follows
cvars.description: 0: Move the camera forwards without changing altitude. 1: Move towards what you are looking

cvars.name: camera_free
cvars.description: Free camera instead of chasing the player

cvars.name: camera_look_attenuation
cvars.description: Attenuation of "looking" movements, only if camera_look_player is set. Bigger is smoother

cvars.name: camera_look_player
cvars.description: Always look to the player. Mouse input is ignored in this mode

cvars.name: camera_mouse_threshold
cvars.description: Use to ignore small mouse movements. This allows for smoother camera control

cvars.name: camera_reset
cvars.description: Resets the camera position and switch to chase mode

cvars.name: camera_speed_attenuation
cvars.description: Camera movements attenuation factor. Bigger is smoother. Applies to mouse movements

cvars.name: camera_speed_chase
cvars.description: Camera movement speed on the x/y/z axis while chasing the player

cvars.name: camera_speed_free
cvars.description: Camera movement speed on the x/y/z axis in free mode

cvars.name: captureleadlimit_override
cvars.description: Capture llead imit overriding the mapinfo specified one (use 0 to play without limit, and -1 to use the mapinfo's limit)

cvars.name: capturelimit_override
cvars.description: Capture limit overriding the mapinfo specified one (use 0 to play without limit, and -1 to use the mapinfo's limit)

cvars.name: chase_back
cvars.description: chase cam distance from the player

cvars.name: chase_front
cvars.description: show frontal view when using chase cam

cvars.name: chase_overhead
cvars.description: chase cam looks straight down if this is not zero

cvars.name: chase_stevie
cvars.description: (GOODVSBAD2 only) chase cam view from above

cvars.name: chase_up
cvars.description: chase cam distance from the player

cvars.name: cl_accuracy_data_receive
cvars.description: 1 receive weapon accuracy data statistics at the end of the match

cvars.name: cl_accuracy_data_share
cvars.description: 1 share my weapon accuracy data statistics with other players, 0 keep my weapon accuracy data statistics hidden

cvars.name: cl_allow_uid2name
cvars.description: -1 = ask if the player wants to disable/enable this feature, 0 = disable, 1 = enable uid2name (allows showing your name in race rankings for instance)

cvars.name: cl_allow_uidranking
cvars.description: 0 = disable, 1 = enable uid ranking (allows statistics like elo to rank you in leaderboards)

cvars.name: cl_allow_uidtracking
cvars.description: -1 = ask if the player wants to disable/enable this feature, 0 = disable, 1 = enable uid tracking (allows associating your data with your player ID)

cvars.name: cl_announcer
cvars.description: name of the announcer you wish to use from data/sound/announcer

cvars.name: cl_announcer_antispam
cvars.description: number of seconds before an announcement of the same sound can be played again

cvars.name: cl_announcer_maptime
cvars.description: play announcer sound telling you the remaining maptime - 0: do not play at all, 1: play at one minute, 2: play at five minutes, 3: play both

cvars.name: cl_arcbeam_simple
cvars.description: use a simplified beam for the Arc instead of accurate flexible poly drawing (improves performance and visuals slightly)

cvars.name: cl_arcbeam_teamcolor
cvars.description: color the Arc beam based on the player's colors

cvars.name: cl_autodemo_delete_keeprecords
cvars.description: when 1, records with a newly made race/cts demo are kept even if cl_autodemo_delete is used to delete demos

cvars.name: cl_autoscreenshot
cvars.description: Take a screenshot upon the end of a match... 0 = Disable completely, 1 = Allow sv_autoscreenshot to take a screenshot when requested, 2 = Always take an autoscreenshot anyway.

cvars.name: cl_autoswitch
cvars.description: automatically switch to newly picked up weapons if they are better than what you are carrying

cvars.name: cl_autotaunt
cvars.description: automatically taunt enemies when fragging them

cvars.name: cl_bob2smooth
cvars.description: how fast the view goes back when you stop touching the ground

cvars.name: cl_bob_limit
cvars.description: limits bobbing to this much distance from view_ofs

cvars.name: cl_bob_limit_heightcheck
cvars.description: check ceiling and floor height against cl_bob_limit and scale down all view bobbing if could result in camera being in solid

cvars.name: cl_bob_limit_heightcheck_dontcrosswatersurface
cvars.description: limit cl_bob_limit to not crossing liquid surfaces also

cvars.name: cl_bob_velocity_limit
cvars.description: limits the xyspeed value in the bobbing code

cvars.name: cl_bobfall
cvars.description: how much the view swings down when falling (influenced by the speed you hit the ground with)

cvars.name: cl_bobfallminspeed
cvars.description: necessary amount of speed for bob-falling to occur

cvars.name: cl_bobup
cvars.description: view bobbing adjustment that makes the up or down swing of the bob last longer

cvars.name: cl_buffs_autoreplace
cvars.description: automatically drop current buff when picking up another

cvars.name: cl_casings_maxcount
cvars.description: maximum amount of shell casings (must be at least 1)

cvars.name: cl_casings_sloppy
cvars.description: sloppy casings, may temporarily penetrate walls

cvars.name: cl_clippedspectating
cvars.description: movement collision for spectators so that you can't pass through walls and such

cvars.name: cl_cts_noautoswitch
cvars.description: Prevent forced switching to new weapons in CTS

cvars.name: cl_curl_enabled
cvars.description: whether client's download support is enabled

cvars.name: cl_curl_maxdownloads
cvars.description: maximum number of concurrent HTTP/FTP downloads

cvars.name: cl_curl_useragent
cvars.description: send the User-Agent string (note: turning this off may break stuff)

cvars.name: cl_curl_useragent_append
cvars.description: a string to append to the User-Agent string (useful for name and version number of your mod)

cvars.name: cl_damageeffect
cvars.description: enable weapon damage effects: 1 enables the feature on skeletal models, 2 on any model

cvars.name: cl_damageeffect_bones
cvars.description: how many damages to allow on a rigged mesh at once (non-skeletal objects are limited to one)

cvars.name: cl_damageeffect_distribute
cvars.description: divide particle intensity if multiple damages are present

cvars.name: cl_damageeffect_lifetime
cvars.description: how much a damage effect lasts, based on damage amount

cvars.name: cl_damageeffect_lifetime_max
cvars.description: maximum lifetime a damage effect may have

cvars.name: cl_damageeffect_lifetime_min
cvars.description: minimum lifetime a damage effect may have

cvars.name: cl_damagetext
cvars.description: Draw damage dealt where you hit the enemy

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_2d
cvars.description: Show damagetext in 2D coordinates if the enemy's location is not known

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_2d_alpha_lifetime
cvars.description: 2D damage text lifetime (alpha fading) in seconds

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_2d_close_range
cvars.description: Always use 2D damagetext for hits closer that this

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_2d_out_of_view
cvars.description: Always use 2D damagetext for hits that occurred off-screen

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_2d_overlap_offset
cvars.description: Offset 2D damage text by this much to prevent overlapping (screen coordinates)

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_2d_pos
cvars.description: 2D damage text initial position (X and Y between 0 and 1)

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_2d_size_lifetime
cvars.description: 2D damage text lifetime (size shrinking) in seconds

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_accumulate_alpha_rel
cvars.description: Only update existing damage text when it's above this much percentage (0 to 1) of the starting alpha

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_accumulate_range
cvars.description: Damage text spawned within this range is accumulated

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_format
cvars.description: How to format the damage text. {health}, {armor}, {total}, {potential}: full damage not capped to target's health, {potential_health}: health damage not capped to target's health

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_format_hide_redundant
cvars.description: hide {armor} if 0; hide {potential} and {potential_health} when same as actual

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_format_verbose
cvars.description: {health} shows {potential_health} too when they differ; {total} shows {potential} too when they differ

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_friendlyfire
cvars.description: 0: never show for friendly fire, 1: when more than 0 damage, 2: always

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_offset_world
cvars.description: Damage text offset (world coordinates relative to player's view)

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_size_max
cvars.description: Damage text font size for large damage

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_size_max_damage
cvars.description: How much damage is considered large

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_size_min
cvars.description: Damage text font size for small damage

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_size_min_damage
cvars.description: How much damage is considered small

cvars.name: cl_damagetext_velocity_world
cvars.description: Damage text move direction (world coordinates relative to player's view)

cvars.name: cl_db_saveasdump
cvars.description: write client.db in dump format (loads slower, easier to read/parse)

cvars.name: cl_deathglow
cvars.description: number of seconds during which dead bodies glow out

cvars.name: cl_deathglow_min
cvars.description: glow out up to this glow factor

cvars.name: cl_dodging
cvars.description: enable dodging, requires sv_dodging_clientselect to be enabled on the server

cvars.name: cl_dodging_timeout
cvars.description: determines how long apart (in seconds) two taps on the same direction key are considered a dodge. use 0 to disable

cvars.name: cl_eventchase_death
cvars.description: camera goes into 3rd person mode when the player is dead; set to 2 to active the effect only when the corpse doesn't move anymore

cvars.name: cl_eventchase_frozen
cvars.description: camera goes into 3rd person mode when the player is frozen

cvars.name: cl_eventchase_generator_distance
cvars.description: final camera distance while viewing generator explosion

cvars.name: cl_eventchase_generator_viewoffset
cvars.description: viewoffset of eventchase camera while viewing generator explosion

cvars.name: cl_eventchase_maxs
cvars.description: max size of eventchase camera bbox

cvars.name: cl_eventchase_mins
cvars.description: min size of eventchase camera bbox

cvars.name: cl_eventchase_nexball
cvars.description: camera goes into 3rd person mode when in nexball game-mode

cvars.name: cl_eventchase_spectated_change
cvars.description: camera goes into 3rd person mode for a moment when changing spectated player

cvars.name: cl_eventchase_spectated_change_time
cvars.description: how much time the effect lasts when changing spectated player

cvars.name: cl_eventchase_speed
cvars.description: how fast the camera slides back, 0 is instant

cvars.name: cl_eventchase_vehicle
cvars.description: camera goes into 3rd person mode when inside a vehicle

cvars.name: cl_firststart
cvars.description: how many times the client has been run

cvars.name: cl_followmodel_velocity_absolute
cvars.description: make the effect ignore velocity direction changes (side effect: it causes a glitch when teleporting / passing through a warpzone)

cvars.name: cl_followmodel_velocity_lowpass
cvars.description: gun following velocity lowpass averaging time

cvars.name: cl_forcemyplayercolors
cvars.description: set to the color value (encoding is same as _cl_color) for your own player model (ignored in teamplay; does not affect how enemies look with cl_forceplayermodels)

cvars.name: cl_forcemyplayermodel
cvars.description: set to the model file name you want to show yourself as (does not affect how enemies look with cl_forceplayermodels)

cvars.name: cl_forcemyplayerskin
cvars.description: set to the skin number you want to show yourself as (does not affect how enemies look with cl_forceplayermodels)

cvars.name: cl_forceplayercolors
cvars.description: make enemies look like your own color (requires server to have sv_defaultcharacter 0); 1: in all game modes without teams (if cl_forceuniqueplayercolors is 0), 2: always, 3: only in Duel, 4: only in game modes with 2 teams, 5: in team games and Duel

cvars.name: cl_forceplayermodels
cvars.description: make everyone look like your own model (requires server to have sv_defaultcharacter 0)

cvars.name: cl_forceuniqueplayercolors
cvars.description: assign each enemy unique colors in all game modes without teams except duel (requires server to have sv_defaultcharacter 0)

cvars.name: cl_gentle
cvars.description: client side gentle mode, master switch

cvars.name: cl_gentle_damage
cvars.description: client side gentle mode for damage flash (hud_damage); when set to 1, a white flash replaces the blood image, when set to 2, a randomly colored flash is used instead

cvars.name: cl_gentle_gibs
cvars.description: client side gentle mode for gibs (cl_nogibs); when set to 1, white smoke replaces gibs, when set to 2, colorful clouds replace gibs

cvars.name: cl_gentle_messages
cvars.description: client side gentle mode for frag messages/centerprints

cvars.name: cl_ghost_items
cvars.description: enable ghosted items (when between 0 and 1, overrides the alpha value)

cvars.name: cl_ghost_items_color
cvars.description: color of ghosted items (colormod format: 0 0 0 leaves the color unchanged, negative values allowed)

cvars.name: cl_gibs_avelocity_scale
cvars.description: how much angular velocity to use on gibs

cvars.name: cl_gibs_maxcount
cvars.description: maximum amount of gibs (must be at least 1)

cvars.name: cl_gibs_sloppy
cvars.description: sloppy gibs, may temporarily penetrate walls

cvars.name: cl_grapplehook_alpha
cvars.description: opacity of the grappling hook chain

cvars.name: cl_gunalign
cvars.description: Gun alignment; 1 = center, 3 = right, 4 = left; requires reconnect

cvars.name: cl_gunoffset
cvars.description: Adjust the weapon viewmodel position, applies only to your own first person view and is relative to cl_gunalign

cvars.name: cl_handicap
cvars.description: multiplies damage received and divides damage dealt

cvars.name: cl_hidewaypoints
cvars.description: disable static waypoints, only show team waypoints

cvars.name: cl_hitsound
cvars.description: play a hit notifier sound when you have hit an enemy, 1: same pitch 2: decrease pitch with more damage 3: increase pitch with more damage

cvars.name: cl_hitsound_antispam_time
cvars.description: don't play the hitsound more often than this

cvars.name: cl_hitsound_nom_damage
cvars.description: damage amount at which hitsound bases pitch off

cvars.name: cl_items_animate
cvars.description: 1 enables bobbing and spinning of 3d items, 2 enables fading out of despawning loot items, 4 enables glowing particles for despawning loot items; add the numbers together to enable that combination.

cvars.name: cl_items_fadedist
cvars.description: distance, relative to the server's g_items_maxdist, at which far away items will start to fade out; 0 disables fading effect

cvars.name: cl_items_vehicle_alpha
cvars.description: Alpha of items seen from inside a vehicle

cvars.name: cl_items_vehicle_color
cvars.description: Colour of items seen from inside a vehicle

cvars.name: cl_jetpack_jump
cvars.description: Activate jetpack by pressing jump in the air. 0 = Disable, 1 = Stop when touching ground, 2 = Enable

cvars.name: cl_jumpspeedcap_max
cvars.description: dummy cvar, value is synced from the server's sv_jumpspeedcap_max setting

cvars.name: cl_jumpspeedcap_min
cvars.description: dummy cvar, value is synced from the server's sv_jumpspeedcap_min setting

cvars.name: cl_lockview
cvars.description: when 1, the camera does not move any more; when 2, you can only control camera angles

cvars.name: cl_maxfps
cvars.description: maximum fps cap, 0 = unlimited, if game is running faster than this it will wait before running another frame (useful to make cpu time available to other programs)

cvars.name: cl_maxfps_alwayssleep
cvars.description: gives up some processing time to other applications each frame, value in milliseconds, disabled if cl_maxfps is 0

cvars.name: cl_maxidlefps
cvars.description: maximum fps cap when the game is not the active window (makes cpu time available to other programs

cvars.name: cl_maxphysicsframesperserverframe
cvars.description: maximum number of physics frames per server frame

cvars.name: cl_minfps
cvars.description: minimum fps target - while the rendering performance is below this, it will drift toward lower quality

cvars.name: cl_minfps_fade
cvars.description: how fast the quality adapts to varying framerate

cvars.name: cl_minfps_force
cvars.description: also apply quality reductions in timedemo/capturevideo

cvars.name: cl_minfps_qualityhysteresis
cvars.description: reduce all quality increments by this to reduce flickering

cvars.name: cl_minfps_qualitymultiply
cvars.description: multiplier for quality changes in quality change per second render time (1 assumes linearity of quality and render time)

cvars.name: cl_minfps_qualitystepmax
cvars.description: maximum quality change in a single frame

cvars.name: cl_modeldetailreduction
cvars.description: higher values will reduce the detail of non-player and non-weapon models (LOD)

cvars.name: cl_movement_errorcompensation
cvars.description: try to compensate for prediction errors and reduce perceived lag

cvars.name: cl_movement_intermissionrunning
cvars.description: keep velocity after the match ends, players may appear to continue running while stationary

cvars.name: cl_multijump
cvars.description: allow multijump mutator, set to -1 for the server to decide whether it's enabled

cvars.name: cl_nade_timer
cvars.description: show a visual timer for nades, 1 = only circle, 2 = circle with text

cvars.name: cl_netlocalping
cvars.description: lags local loopback connection by this much ping time (useful to play more fairly on your own server with people with higher pings)

cvars.name: cl_netpacketloss_receive
cvars.description: drops this percentage of incoming packets, useful for testing network protocol robustness (jerky movement, effects failing to start, sounds failing to play, etc)

cvars.name: cl_netpacketloss_send

cvars.description: increase player respawn delay based on the number of lives less than the leader (NOTE: delay doesn't increase when only 2 players are left alive)

cvars.name: g_lms_dynamic_respawn_delay_increase
cvars.description: increase base player respawn delay by this amount of time for each life less than the leader

cvars.name: g_lms_dynamic_vampire
cvars.description: attackers receive a fraction of health removed from enemies based on the number of lives less than the enemy

cvars.name: g_lms_dynamic_vampire_factor_increase
cvars.description: increase vampire factor by this fraction for each life less than the enemy

cvars.name: g_lms_dynamic_vampire_min_lives_diff
cvars.description: number of lives the attacker must have less than the enemy to receive the base fraction of health

cvars.name: g_lms_forfeit_min_match_time
cvars.description: end the match early if at least this many seconds have elapsed and less than 2 players are playing due to forfeits

cvars.name: g_lms_items
cvars.description: enables items to spawn, weaponarena still disables weapons and ammo (to force all items to spawn, use g_pickup_items 1 instead)

cvars.name: g_lms_join_anytime
cvars.description: 1: new players can join, but get same amount of lives as the worst player; 0: new players can only join if the worst active player has (fraglimit - g_lms_last_join) or more lives

cvars.name: g_lms_last_join
cvars.description: if g_lms_join_anytime is 0, new players can only join if the worst active player has (fraglimit - g_lms_last_join) or more lives; in other words, new players can no longer join once the worst player loses more than g_lms_last_join lives

cvars.name: g_lms_leader_lives_diff
cvars.description: players leading by at least this number of lives are considered leaders and are more visible

cvars.name: g_lms_leader_minpercent
cvars.description: leading players are not considered leaders only if they are more than this percentage of total players

cvars.name: g_lms_leader_wp_interval
cvars.description: periodically show again waypoints for leaders after this amount of time

cvars.name: g_lms_leader_wp_interval_jitter
cvars.description: jitter waypoint interval by this amount of time

cvars.name: g_lms_leader_wp_time
cvars.description: show waypoints for leaders only for this amount of time

cvars.name: g_lms_regenerate
cvars.description: health and/or armor regeneration, according to g_balance_health_regen and g_balance_armor_regen

cvars.name: g_lms_rot
cvars.description: health and/or armor rotting, according to g_balance_health_rot and g_balance_armor_rot

cvars.name: g_lms_weaponarena
cvars.description: starting weapons - takes the same options as g_weaponarena

cvars.name: g_mapinfo_allow_unsupported_modes_and_let_stuff_break
cvars.description: set to 1 to be able to force game types using g_ cvars even if the map does not support them

cvars.name: g_mapinfo_q3compat
cvars.description: 0: generate .mapinfo if none exists, ignoring .arena and .defi files. 1: read .arena and .defi files, don't generate .mapinfo. 2: generate .mapinfo if none exists using data from .arena files instead of reading them, .defi files continue to be used directly

cvars.name: g_maplist
cvars.description: the list of maps to be cycled among (is autogenerated if empty)

cvars.name: g_maplist_allow_frustrating
cvars.description: allow impossible maps to be, e.g., voted for and in the maplist (if set to 2, ONLY impossible maps are allowed)

cvars.name: g_maplist_allow_hidden
cvars.description: allow hidden maps to be, e.g., voted for and in the maplist

cvars.name: g_maplist_check_waypoints
cvars.description: when 1, maps are skipped if there currently are bots, but the map has no waypoints

cvars.name: g_maplist_ignore_sizes
cvars.description: when 1, all maps are shown in the map list regardless of player count

cvars.name: g_maplist_index
cvars.description: this is used internally for saving position in maplist cycle

cvars.name: g_maplist_mostrecent
cvars.description: contains the name of the maps that were most recently played

cvars.name: g_maplist_mostrecent_count
cvars.description: number of most recent maps that are blocked from being played again

cvars.name: g_maplist_selectrandom
cvars.description: if 1, a random map will be chosen as next map - DEPRECATED in favor of g_maplist_shuffle

cvars.name: g_maplist_shuffle
cvars.description: new randomization method: like selectrandom, but avoid playing the same maps in short succession. This works by taking out the first element and inserting it into g_maplist with a bias to the end of the list

cvars.name: g_maplist_sizes_count_bots
cvars.description: include the number of bots currently in the server when counting the number of players for size restrictions

cvars.name: g_maplist_sizes_count_maxplayers
cvars.description: check the player limit when getting the player count so forced spectators don't affect the size restrictions

cvars.name: g_maplist_sizes_specparty
cvars.description: this fraction of people are expected to only spectate, reduces player count used to select voting GUI maps

cvars.name: g_maplist_votable
cvars.description: number of maps that are shown in the map voting at the end of a match, 0 to disable

cvars.name: g_maplist_votable_abstain
cvars.description: offer a "don't care" option on the voting screen

cvars.name: g_maplist_votable_keeptwotime
cvars.description: show only 2 options after this amount of time during map vote screen

cvars.name: g_maplist_votable_nodetail
cvars.description: hide per-map vote counts (to avoid influential first votes)

cvars.name: g_maplist_votable_screenshot_dir
cvars.description: where to look for map screenshots

cvars.name: g_maplist_votable_suggestions
cvars.description: number of maps a player is allowed to suggest for the map voting screen using 'suggestmap'

cvars.name: g_maplist_votable_suggestions_override_mostrecent
cvars.description: allow players to suggest maps that have been played recently

cvars.name: g_maplist_votable_timeout
cvars.description: timeout for the map voting; must be below 50 seconds!

cvars.name: g_max_info_autoscreenshot
cvars.description: how many info_autoscreenshot entities are allowed

cvars.name: g_maxplayers
cvars.description: maximum number of players allowed to play at the same time, 0 means unlimited, -1 uses the map setting or unlimited if not set (rounded to multiple of team number)

cvars.name: g_maxplayers_spectator_blocktime
cvars.description: if the players voted for the "nospectators" command, this setting defines the number of seconds a observer/spectator has time to join the game before they get kicked

cvars.name: g_maxpushtime
cvars.description: timeout for kill credit when your damage knocks someone into a death trap

cvars.name: g_maxspeed
cvars.description: player speed limit, faster players are killed (0 for unlimited speed)

cvars.name: g_mayhem
cvars.description: Mayhem: Compete for the most damage dealt and kills in this chaotic mayhem!

cvars.name: g_mayhem_pickup_items_remove_weapons_and_ammo
cvars.description: when pickup items are enabled in mayhem still remove weapons and ammo pickups

cvars.name: g_mayhem_point_leadlimit
cvars.description: Mayhem score lead limit overriding the mapinfo specified one (use 0 to play without limit, and -1 to use the mapinfo's limit)

cvars.name: g_mayhem_point_limit
cvars.description: Mayhem score limit overriding the mapinfo specified one (use 0 to play without limit, and -1 to use the mapinfo's limit)

cvars.name: g_mayhem_powerups
cvars.description: Allow powerups in mayhem. Only checked if g_powerups is -1 therefore this will be overridden by g_powerups 1 or 0

cvars.name: g_mayhem_regenerate
cvars.description: health and/or armor regeneration, according to g_balance_health_regen and g_balance_armor_regen

cvars.name: g_mayhem_rot
cvars.description: health and/or armor rotting, according to g_balance_health_rot and g_balance_armor_rot

cvars.name: g_mayhem_scoring_damage_weight
cvars.description: how much is damage equal to player's spawning health+armor worth in frags

cvars.name: g_mayhem_scoring_disable_selfdamage2score
cvars.description: disable reducing score with self damage at the cost of full penalty for suicides regardless of how much health was lost suiciding

cvars.name: g_mayhem_scoring_kill_weight
cvars.description: how much is a kill worth in frags

cvars.name: g_mayhem_scoring_upscaler
cvars.description: upscale one frag's worth to be this amount of in score

cvars.name: g_mayhem_selfdamage
cvars.description: 0 = disable selfdamage in mayhem, 1 = enable selfdamage in mayhem

cvars.name: g_mayhem_weaponarena
cvars.description: starting weapons - takes the same options as g_weaponarena

cvars.name: g_midair
cvars.description: if set to 1 you can only apply damage to your opponent while they are airborne

cvars.name: g_midair_shieldtime
cvars.description: number of seconds you are still invincible since you lost contact to the ground

cvars.name: g_mirrordamage_onlyweapons
cvars.description: for teamplay_mode 4: only apply mirror damage if the attack was from a weapon

cvars.name: g_mirrordamage_virtual
cvars.description: for teamplay_mode 4: do not actually apply mirror damage, just show graphics effect for it

cvars.name: g_monsters_skill
cvars.description: Monster skill (affecting some of their attributes). 1 - easy, 2 - medium, 3 - hard, 4 - insane, 5 - nightmare

cvars.name: g_movement_highspeed
cvars.description: multiplier scale for movement speed (applies to sv_maxspeed and sv_maxairspeed, also applies to air acceleration when g_movement_highspeed_q3_compat is set to 0)

cvars.name: g_movement_highspeed_q3_compat
cvars.description: apply speed modifiers to air movement in a more Q3-compatible way (only apply speed buffs and g_movement_highspeed to max air speed, not to acceleration)

cvars.name: g_multijump
cvars.description: Number of multiple jumps to allow (jumping again in the air), -1 allows for infinite jumps

cvars.name: g_multijump_add
cvars.description: 0 = make the current z velocity equal to jumpvelocity, 1 = add jumpvelocity to the current z velocity

cvars.name: g_multijump_client
cvars.description: If the client sets cl_multijump to -1, this setting is used for them as a default

cvars.name: g_multijump_speed
cvars.description: Minimum vertical speed a player must have in order to jump again

cvars.name: g_nades
cvars.description: enable off-hand grenades - use the 'dropweapon' (second press throws) or '+hook' (release throws) binds

cvars.name: g_nades_bonus_client_select
cvars.description: Allow client side selection of bonus nade type

cvars.name: g_nades_bonus_only
cvars.description: Disallow regular nades, only bonus nades can be used

cvars.name: g_nades_bonus_onstrength
cvars.description: Always give bonus grenades to players that have the strength powerup

cvars.name: g_nades_bonus_score_low
cvars.description: Score given for frags and unfreezes

cvars.name: g_nades_bonus_score_max
cvars.description: Score value that will give a bonus nade

cvars.name: g_nades_bonus_score_medium
cvars.description: Score given for flag returns and flag carrier kills

cvars.name: g_nades_bonus_score_minor
cvars.description: Score given for minor actions (pickups, regular frags etc.)

cvars.name: g_nades_bonus_score_spree
cvars.description: Score given every spree of this many frags

cvars.name: g_nades_bonus_score_time

cvars.name: g_nades_bonus_score_time_flagcarrier
cvars.description: Bonus nade score given per second as flag carrier (negative to have the score decay)

cvars.name: g_nades_client_select

cvars.name: g_nades_entrap_strength
cvars.description: Strength of the orb's movement slowing powers

cvars.name: g_nades_heal_foe
cvars.description: Multiplier of health given to enemies

cvars.name: g_nades_heal_friend
cvars.description: Multiplier of health given to team mates

cvars.name: g_nades_heal_time
cvars.description: How long the healing field will last

cvars.name: g_nades_ice_freeze_time
cvars.description: How long the ice field will last

cvars.name: g_nades_ice_health
cvars.description: How much health the player will have after being unfrozen

cvars.name: g_nades_nade_newton_style
cvars.description: nade velocity: 0 is absolute, 1 is relative (takes into account player velocity), 2 is something in between

cvars.name: g_nades_nade_small
cvars.description: Use smaller nade size, makes shooting them harder, legacy setting

cvars.name: g_nades_napalm_ball_count
cvars.description: Number of fireballs emitted during the explosion

cvars.name: g_nades_napalm_ball_radius
cvars.description: Distance from the fireball within which you may get burned

cvars.name: g_nades_napalm_ball_spread
cvars.description: Maximum force which the fireballs will have on explosion

cvars.name: g_nades_napalm_blast
cvars.description: Whether the napalm grenades also give damage with the usual grenade explosion

cvars.name: g_nades_napalm_burntime
cvars.description: Time that the fire from napalm will stick to the player

cvars.name: g_nades_napalm_fountain_damage
cvars.description: Damage caused by the center of the fountain

cvars.name: g_nades_napalm_fountain_delay
cvars.description: Delay between emissions by the fountain

cvars.name: g_nades_napalm_fountain_edgedamage
cvars.description: Damage caused by the edge of the fountain

cvars.name: g_nades_napalm_fountain_lifetime
cvars.description: Time period during which extra fire mines are ejected

cvars.name: g_nades_napalm_selfdamage
cvars.description: Whether the player that tossed the nade can be harmed by its fire

cvars.name: g_nades_pickup
cvars.description: allow picking up thrown nades (not your own)

cvars.name: g_nades_pickup_time
cvars.description: time until picked up nade explodes

cvars.name: g_nades_pokenade_monster_lifetime
cvars.description: How long pokenade monster will survive

cvars.name: g_nades_spawn
cvars.description: give nades right away when player spawns rather than delaying entire refire

cvars.name: g_nades_spawn_count
cvars.description: Number of times player will spawn at their spawn nade explosion location

cvars.name: g_nades_spread
cvars.description: random spread offset of throw direction

cvars.name: g_new_toys
cvars.description: Mutator 'New Toys': enable extra fun guns

cvars.name: g_new_toys_autoreplace
cvars.description: 0: never replace, 1: always auto replace guns by available new toys, 2: randomly auto replace guns by available new toys

cvars.name: g_new_toys_use_pickupsound
cvars.description: play the 'new toys, new toys!' roflsound when picking up a new toys weapon

cvars.name: g_nexball
cvars.description: Nexball: Basketball and Soccer go Xonotic

cvars.description: velocity loss when the ball bounces

cvars.name: g_nexball_basketball_bouncestop
cvars.description: speed at which the ball stops when it hits the ground (multiplied by sv_gravity)

cvars.name: g_nexball_basketball_delay_hold
cvars.description: time before a player who caught the ball loses it (anti-ballcamp)

cvars.name: g_nexball_basketball_delay_hold_forteam
cvars.description: time before a ball reset when a team holds the ball for too long

cvars.name: g_nexball_basketball_effects_default
cvars.description: default: dim light. The original version used 1024 (fire) but it gives bad performance

cvars.name: g_nexball_basketball_jumppad
cvars.description: whether basketballs should be pushable by jumppads

cvars.name: g_nexball_basketball_meter
cvars.description: use the power meter for basketball

cvars.name: g_nexball_basketball_meter_maxpower
cvars.description: maximal multiplier to the launching speed when using the power meter

cvars.name: g_nexball_basketball_meter_minpower
cvars.description: minimal multiplier to the launching speed when using the power meter

cvars.name: g_nexball_basketball_teamsteal
cvars.description: 1 to allow players to steal from teammates, 0 to disallow

cvars.name: g_nexball_delay_collect
cvars.description: time before the same player can catch the ball they launched

cvars.name: g_nexball_delay_goal

cvars.name: g_nexball_delay_idle
cvars.description: maximal idle time before a reset

cvars.name: g_nexball_delay_start

cvars.name: g_nexball_football_boost_up
cvars.description: vertical velocity boost when the ball is touched

cvars.name: g_nexball_football_bouncefactor
cvars.description: velocity loss when the ball bounces

cvars.name: g_nexball_football_bouncestop
cvars.description: speed at which the ball stops when it hits the ground (multiplied by sv_gravity)

cvars.name: g_nexball_football_jumppad
cvars.description: whether footballs should be pushable by jumppads

cvars.name: g_nexball_football_physics
cvars.description: 0: Revenant's original movement, 1: 0 but half independant of aiming height, 2: 1 fully independant, -1: first recode try

cvars.name: g_nexball_goalleadlimit
cvars.description: Nexball goal lead limit overriding the mapinfo specified one (use 0 to play without limit, and -1 to use the mapinfo's limit)

cvars.name: g_nexball_goallimit
cvars.description: Nexball goal limit overriding the mapinfo specified one (use 0 to play without limit, and -1 to use the mapinfo's limit)

cvars.name: g_nexball_meter_period
cvars.description: time to make a full cycle on the power meter

cvars.name: g_nexball_playerclip_collisions
cvars.description: make the ball bounce off clips

cvars.name: g_nexball_radar_showallplayers
cvars.description: 1: show every player and the ball on the radar  0: only show teammates and the ball on the radar

cvars.name: g_nexball_safepass_holdtime
cvars.description: How long to remeber last teammate you pointed at

cvars.name: g_nexball_safepass_maxdist
cvars.description: Max distance to allow save fassping (0 to turn off safe passing)

cvars.name: g_nexball_safepass_turnrate
cvars.description: How fast the safe-pass ball can habge direction

cvars.name: g_nexball_trail_color
cvars.description: 1-256 for different colors (Quake palette, 254 is white)

cvars.name: g_nexball_viewmodel_offset
cvars.description: Where the ball is located on carrier forward right up

cvars.name: g_nexball_viewmodel_scale
cvars.description: How large the ball for the carrier

cvars.name: g_nick_flood_penalty
cvars.description: duration of the nick flood penalty

cvars.name: g_nick_flood_penalty_red
cvars.description: number of changes to allow before totally disorienting the player

cvars.name: g_nick_flood_penalty_yellow
cvars.description: number of changes to allow before warning and movement blocking

cvars.name: g_nick_flood_timeout
cvars.description: time after which nick flood protection resets (set to 0 to disable nick flood checking)

cvars.name: g_nix

cvars.name: g_nix_with_blaster
cvars.description: always carry the blaster as an additional weapon in NIX

cvars.name: g_nix_with_healtharmor
cvars.description: when 1, health and armor still show up in NIX

cvars.name: g_nix_with_powerups
cvars.description: when 1, powerups still show up in NIX

cvars.name: g_norecoil
cvars.description: if set to 1 shooting weapons won't make you crosshair to move upwards (recoil)

cvars.name: g_onslaught
cvars.description: Onslaught: take control points towards the enemy generator and then destroy it

cvars.name: g_onslaught_click_radius
cvars.description: When choosing from the map, this level of precision is required

cvars.name: g_onslaught_cp_proxydecap
cvars.description: de-capture controlpoints by standing close to them

cvars.name: g_onslaught_point_limit
cvars.description: Onslaught point limit overriding the mapinfo specified one (use 0 to play without limit, and -1 to use the mapinfo's limit)

cvars.name: g_onslaught_spawn_choose

cvars.name: g_onslaught_teleport_radius

cvars.name: g_onslaught_teleport_wait
cvars.description: Time before player can teleport again

cvars.name: g_onslaught_warmup

cvars.description: internal cvar, to enable overkill, use `exec ruleset-overkill.cfg`

cvars.name: g_overkill_blaster_keepdamage
cvars.description: allow secondary fire to hurt players

cvars.name: g_overkill_blaster_keepforce
cvars.description: allow secondary fire to push players

cvars.name: g_overkill_itemwaypoints
cvars.description: show waypoints with timer before health and armor spawns

cvars.name: g_overkill_powerups_replace
cvars.description: replace strength and shield with HMG and RPC

cvars.name: g_overkill_weapons
cvars.description: Whether to enable overkill weapons outside of overkill ruleset.

cvars.name: g_physical_items
cvars.description: 1 uses ODE physics for dropped weapons, 2 for all items, requires physics_ode to be enabled

cvars.name: g_physical_items_damageforcescale
cvars.description: how affected physical weapons are by damage

cvars.name: g_physical_items_reset
cvars.description: return map items to their original location after being picked up

cvars.name: g_physics_clientselect
cvars.description: allow clients to select their physics set

cvars.name: g_physics_clientselect_options
cvars.default: xonotic nexuiz quake warsow defrag quake3 vecxis quake2 bones

cvars.name: g_pickup_items
cvars.description: if set to 0 all items (health, armor, ammo, weapons...) are removed from the map, if 1 they are forced to spawn

cvars.name: g_pickup_respawntime_initial_random
cvars.description: For items that don't start spawned: 0: spawn after their normal respawntime; 1: spawn after `random * respawntime` with the *same* random; 2: same as 1 but each item has separate random

cvars.name: g_pickup_respawntime_scaling_linear
cvars.description: Multiply respawn time by `reciprocal / (p + offset) + linear` where `p` is the current number of players, takes effect with 2 or more players present, `linear` can be used to simply scale the respawn time linearly

cvars.name: g_pickup_respawntime_scaling_offset
cvars.description: Multiply respawn time by `reciprocal / (p + offset) + linear` where `p` is the current number of players, takes effect with 2 or more players present, `offset` offsets the curve left or right - the results are not intuitive and I recommend plotting the respawn time and the number of items per player to see what's happening

cvars.name: g_pickup_respawntime_scaling_reciprocal
cvars.description: Multiply respawn time by `reciprocal / (p + offset) + linear` where `p` is the current number of players, takes effect with 2 or more players present, `reciprocal` (with `offset` and `linear` set to 0) can be used to achieve a constant number of items spawned *per player*

cvars.name: g_pinata

cvars.name: g_pinata_offhand
cvars.description: if enabled, the second weapon will drop as well while dual wielding

cvars.name: g_playban_list

cvars.name: g_playban_minigames

cvars.name: g_player_damageforcescale

cvars.name: g_playerstats_gamereport_uri

cvars.name: g_random_start_weapons
cvars.default: machinegun mortar electro crylink vortex hagar devastator

cvars.name: g_respawn_delay_forced
cvars.description: enforce regular respawn delay (prevent gamemode specific respawn delays)

cvars.name: g_respawn_delay_large
cvars.description: large game number of seconds you have to wait before you can respawn again

cvars.name: g_respawn_delay_large_count
cvars.description: Player count per team for g_respawn_delay_large. <=0 values mean the minimum amount of players to have gameplay (typically 2 in FFA, 1 in teamplay).

cvars.name: g_respawn_delay_max
cvars.description: number of seconds you can wait before you're forced to respawn (only effective with g_forced_respawn 1)

cvars.name: g_respawn_delay_small
cvars.description: small game number of seconds you have to wait before you can respawn again

cvars.name: g_respawn_delay_small_count
cvars.description: Player count per team for g_respawn_delay_small. <=0 values mean the minimum amount of players to have gameplay (typically 2 in FFA, 1 in teamplay).

cvars.name: g_respawn_ghosts
cvars.description: if 1 dead bodies become ghosts and float away when the player respawns

cvars.name: g_respawn_ghosts_fadetime
cvars.description: amount of time a respawn ghost takes to fade out

cvars.name: g_respawn_ghosts_speed
cvars.description: the speed with which respawn ghosts float and rotate

cvars.name: g_respawn_ghosts_time
cvars.description: amount of time a respawn ghost lasts before it starts fading out. 0 disables and ghosts fade when the body would

cvars.name: g_respawn_waves
cvars.description: respawn in waves (every n seconds), intended to decrease overwhelming base attacks

cvars.name: g_rm
cvars.description: enable rocket minsta (explosive vaporizer primary, secondary laser prong)

cvars.name: g_rm_laser_damage
cvars.description: laser damage, divided by laser count

cvars.name: g_rm_laser_force
cvars.description: laser force, divided by laser count

cvars.name: g_rm_laser_rapid
cvars.description: fast refire after holding down laser for certain amount of time

cvars.name: g_rm_laser_rapid_delay
cvars.description: delay before turning on rapid laser mode

cvars.name: g_rocket_flying
cvars.description: make rocket jumping easier - use the remote_jump weapon cvars for selfdamage and selfpush force

cvars.name: g_rocket_flying_disabledelays
cvars.description: disable detonation delays on rockets and mines

cvars.name: g_running_guns
cvars.description: ... or wonder, till it drives you mad, what would have followed if you had.

cvars.name: g_sandbox
cvars.description: allow players to spawn and edit objects around the map

cvars.name: g_sandbox_editor_distance_edit
cvars.description: distance at which players can edit or remove objects they are looking at

cvars.name: g_sandbox_editor_distance_spawn
cvars.description: distance at which objects spawn in front of the player

cvars.name: g_sandbox_editor_flood
cvars.description: players must wait this many seconds between spawning objects

cvars.name: g_sandbox_editor_free
cvars.description: 0 = players can only copy or edit their own objects, 1 = players can copy but not edit other objects, 2 = players can copy and edit all object

cvars.name: g_sandbox_editor_maxobjects
cvars.description: maximum number of objects that may exist at a time

cvars.name: g_sandbox_info
cvars.description: print object information to the server. 1 prints info about spawned / removed objects, 2 also prints info about edited objects

cvars.name: g_sandbox_object_material_velocity_factor
cvars.description: velocity range which decides the intensity of material effects

cvars.name: g_sandbox_object_material_velocity_min
cvars.description: velocity objects must have while colliding for material effects to be applied

cvars.name: g_sandbox_object_scale_max
cvars.description: maximum scale that objects can be set to

cvars.name: g_sandbox_object_scale_min
cvars.description: minimum scale that objects can be set to

cvars.name: g_sandbox_readonly
cvars.description: when this mode is active, players cannot modify objects or use any sandbox commands

cvars.name: g_sandbox_storage_autoload
cvars.description: if a storage file exists for the given map, automatically load it at startup

cvars.name: g_sandbox_storage_autosave
cvars.description: storage is automatically saved every specified number of seconds

cvars.name: g_sandbox_storage_name
cvars.description: name of the selected storage to use

cvars.name: g_shootfromcenter
cvars.description: weapon gets moved to the center, shots still come from the barrel of your weapon; visual gun position can still be influenced by cl_gunalign 1 and 2

cvars.name: g_shootfromeye
cvars.description: shots are fired from your eye/crosshair; visual gun position can still be influenced by cl_gunalign 1 and 2

cvars.name: g_shootfromfixedorigin
cvars.description: if set to a string like 0 y z, the gun is moved to the given y and z coordinates. If set to a string like x y z, the whole shot origin is used

cvars.name: g_showweaponspawns
cvars.description: 1: display waypoints for weapon spawns found on the map when a weapon key is pressed and the weapon is not owned; 2: for dropped weapons too; 3: for all the weapons sharing the same impulse

cvars.name: g_smneg
cvars.description: Stale-move negation: penalize repeated use of the same weapon

cvars.name: g_smneg_bonus
cvars.description: Stale-move negation: allow weapons to become stronger than their baseline

cvars.name: g_smneg_bonus_asymptote
cvars.description: Stale-move negation: damage = infinity at this bonus level

cvars.name: g_spawn_alloweffects
cvars.description: allow clients to enable spawn point and event effects such as particles and sounds, see cl_spawn_ cvars for more info

cvars.name: g_spawn_furthest
cvars.description: this amount of the spawns shall be far away from any players

cvars.name: g_spawn_near_teammate
cvars.description: players prefer spawns near a team mate

cvars.name: g_spawn_near_teammate_distance
cvars.description: max distance to consider a spawn to be near a team mate

cvars.name: g_spawn_near_teammate_ignore_spawnpoint
cvars.description: ignore spawnpoints and spawn right at team mates, if 2, clients can ignore this option

cvars.name: g_spawn_near_teammate_ignore_spawnpoint_check_health
cvars.description: only allow spawn at this player if their health is full

cvars.name: g_spawn_near_teammate_ignore_spawnpoint_closetodeath
cvars.description: spawn as close to death location as possible

cvars.name: g_spawn_near_teammate_ignore_spawnpoint_delay
cvars.description: how long to wait before its OK to spawn at a player after someone just spawned at this player

cvars.name: g_spawn_near_teammate_ignore_spawnpoint_delay_death
cvars.description: how long to wait before its OK to spawn at a player after death

cvars.name: g_spawn_near_teammate_ignore_spawnpoint_max
cvars.description: if set, test at most this many of the available teammates

cvars.name: g_spawn_useallspawns
cvars.description: use all spawns, e.g. also team spawns in non-teamplay, and all spawns, even enemy spawns, in teamplay

cvars.name: g_spawnpoints_auto_move_out_of_solid
cvars.description: show a warning if a spawn point was placed inside a solid, disabling this setting causes such spawn points to be removed and produce a more verbose error message

cvars.name: g_spawnshield_blockdamage
cvars.description: how much spawn shield protects you from damage (1 = full protection)

cvars.name: g_spawnshieldtime
cvars.description: number of seconds you are invincible after you spawned, this shield is lost after you fire

cvars.name: g_start_delay
cvars.description: delay before the game starts, so everyone can join; recommended to set this to like 15 on a public server

cvars.name: g_superspectate
cvars.description: server side, allows extended spectator functions through the cmd interface. followpowerup, followstrength, followshield or followfc [red|blue] will transfer spectation to the relevent player, if any

cvars.name: g_survival
cvars.description: Survival: identify and eliminate all the hunters before all your allies are gone

cvars.name: g_survival_hunter_count
cvars.description: number of players who will become hunters, set between 0 and 0.9 to use a multiplier of the current players, or 1 and above to specify an exact number of players

cvars.name: g_survival_not_lms_maps
cvars.description: when this is set, LMS maps will NOT be listed in survival

cvars.name: g_survival_punish_teamkill
cvars.description: kill the player when they kill an ally

cvars.name: g_survival_reward_survival
cvars.description: give a point to all surviving players if the round timelimit is reached, in addition to the points given for kills

cvars.name: g_survival_warmup
cvars.description: how long the players will have time to run around the map before the round starts

cvars.name: g_tdm
cvars.description: Team Deathmatch: the team who kills their opponents most often wins

cvars.name: g_tdm_on_dm_maps
cvars.description: when this is set, all DM maps automatically support TDM

cvars.name: g_tdm_point_leadlimit
cvars.description: TDM point lead limit overriding the mapinfo specified one (use 0 to play without limit, and -1 to use the mapinfo's limit)

cvars.name: g_tdm_point_limit
cvars.description: TDM point limit overriding the mapinfo specified one (use 0 to play without limit, and -1 to use the mapinfo's limit)

cvars.name: g_tdm_team_spawns
cvars.description: when 1, players spawn from the team spawnpoints of the map, if any

cvars.name: g_tdm_teams
cvars.description: how many teams are in team deathmatch (set by mapinfo)

cvars.name: g_tdm_teams_override
cvars.description: how many teams are in team deathmatch

cvars.name: g_teamdamage_resetspeed
cvars.description: for teamplay_mode 4: how fast player's teamdamage count decreases

cvars.name: g_teamdamage_threshold
cvars.description: for teamplay_mode 4: threshold over which to apply mirror damage

cvars.name: g_telefrags
cvars.description: telefragging, i.e. killing someone who stands in the way of someone who is teleporting

cvars.name: g_telefrags_avoid
cvars.description: when teleporters have a random destination, avoid teleporting to locations where a telefrag would happen

cvars.name: g_teleport_maxspeed
cvars.description: maximum speed that a player can keep when going through a teleporter (if a misc_teleporter_dest also has a cap the smallest one of these will be used), 0 = don't limit, -1 = keep no speed

cvars.name: g_throughfloor_damage_max_stddev
cvars.description: Maximum standard deviation for splash damage

cvars.name: g_throughfloor_debug
cvars.description: enable debugging messages for throughfloor calculations

cvars.name: g_throughfloor_force_max_stddev
cvars.description: Maximum standard deviation for splash force

cvars.name: g_throughfloor_max_steps_other
cvars.description: Maximum number of steps for splash damage

cvars.name: g_throughfloor_max_steps_player
cvars.description: Maximum number of steps for splash damage

cvars.name: g_throughfloor_min_steps_other
cvars.description: Minimum number of steps for splash damage

cvars.name: g_throughfloor_min_steps_player
cvars.description: Minimum number of steps for splash damage

cvars.name: g_tka
cvars.description: another game mode which focuses around a ball

cvars.name: g_tka_ballcarrier_damage
cvars.description: damage multiplier while holding the ball

cvars.name: g_tka_ballcarrier_effects
cvars.description: Add together the numbers you want: EF_ADDITIVE (32) / EF_NODEPTHTEST (8192) / EF_DIMLIGHT (8)

cvars.name: g_tka_ballcarrier_force
cvars.description: force multiplier while holding the ball

cvars.name: g_tka_ballcarrier_highspeed
cvars.description: speed multiplier done to the person holding the ball (recommended when used with some mutators)

cvars.name: g_tka_ballcarrier_selfdamage
cvars.description: self damage multiplier while holding the ball

cvars.name: g_tka_ballcarrier_selfforce
cvars.description: self force multiplier while holding the ball

cvars.name: g_tka_noncarrier_damage

cvars.description: Automatically create waypoints for bots while playing; BEWARE, this currently creates too many of them

cvars.name: mod_alias_force_animated
cvars.description: if set to an non-empty string, overrides the is-animated flag of any alias models (for benchmarking)

cvars.name: mod_alias_supporttagscale
cvars.description: support scaling factors in bone/tag attachment matrices as supported by MD3

cvars.name: mod_bsp_portalize
cvars.description: enables portal generation from BSP tree (may take several seconds per map), used by r_drawportals, r_useportalculling, r_shadow_realtime_world_compileportalculling, sv_cullentities_portal

cvars.name: mod_collision_bih
cvars.description: enables use of generated Bounding Interval Hierarchy tree instead of compiled bsp tree in collision code

cvars.name: mod_generatelightmaps_borderpixels
cvars.description: extra space around polygons to prevent sampling artifacts

cvars.name: mod_generatelightmaps_gridradius
cvars.description: sampling area around each lightgrid cell center

cvars.name: mod_generatelightmaps_gridsamples
cvars.description: number of shadow tests done per lightgrid cell

cvars.name: mod_generatelightmaps_lightmapradius
cvars.description: sampling area around each lightmap pixel

cvars.name: mod_generatelightmaps_lightmapsamples
cvars.description: number of shadow tests done per lightmap pixel

cvars.name: mod_generatelightmaps_vertexsamples
cvars.description: number of shadow tests done per vertex

cvars.name: mod_noshader_default_offsetmapping
cvars.description: use offsetmapping by default on all surfaces that are not using q3 shader files

cvars.name: mod_obj_orientation
cvars.description: fix orientation of OBJ models to the usual conventions (if zero, use coordinates as is)

cvars.name: mod_q1bsp_polygoncollisions
cvars.description: disables use of precomputed cliphulls and instead collides with polygons (uses Bounding Interval Hierarchy optimizations)

cvars.name: mod_q2bsp_littransparentsurfaces
cvars.description: allows lighting on rain in 3v3gloom3 and other cases of transparent surfaces that have lightmaps that were ignored by quake2

cvars.name: mod_q3bsp_curves_collisions_stride
cvars.description: collisions against curves: optimize performance by doing a combined collision check for this triangle amount first (-1 avoids any box tests)

cvars.name: mod_q3bsp_curves_stride
cvars.description: particle effect collisions against curves: optimize performance by doing a combined collision check for this triangle amount first (-1 avoids any box tests)

cvars.name: mod_q3bsp_debugtracebrush
cvars.description: selects different tracebrush bsp recursion algorithms (for debugging purposes only)

cvars.name: mod_q3bsp_lightmapmergepower
cvars.description: merges the quake3 128x128 lightmap textures into larger lightmap group textures to speed up rendering, 1 = 256x256, 2 = 512x512, 3 = 1024x1024, 4 = 2048x2048, 5 = 4096x4096, ...

cvars.name: mod_q3bsp_nolightmaps
cvars.description: do not load lightmaps in Q3BSP maps (to save video RAM, but be warned: it looks ugly)

cvars.name: mod_q3bsp_optimizedtraceline
cvars.description: whether to use optimized traceline code for line traces (as opposed to tracebox code)

cvars.name: mod_q3bsp_sRGBlightmaps
cvars.description: treat lightmaps from Q3 maps as sRGB when vid_sRGB is active

cvars.name: mod_q3bsp_tracelineofsight_brushes
cvars.description: enables culling of entities behind detail brushes, curves, etc

cvars.name: mod_q3shader_default_offsetmapping
cvars.description: use offsetmapping by default on all surfaces that are using q3 shader files

cvars.name: mod_q3shader_default_polygonfactor
cvars.description: biases depth values of 'polygonoffset' shaders to prevent z-fighting artifacts

cvars.name: mod_q3shader_default_polygonoffset
cvars.description: biases depth values of 'polygonoffset' shaders to prevent z-fighting artifacts

cvars.name: mod_q3shader_force_addalpha
cvars.description: treat GL_ONE GL_ONE (or add) blendfunc as GL_SRC_ALPHA GL_ONE for compatibility with older DarkPlaces releases

cvars.name: mod_q3shader_force_terrain_alphaflag
cvars.description: for multilayered terrain shaders force TEXF_ALPHA flag on both layers

cvars.name: mod_recalculatenodeboxes
cvars.description: enables use of generated node bounding boxes based on BSP tree portal reconstruction, rather than the node boxes supplied by the map compiler

cvars.name: net_address
cvars.description: network address to open ipv4 ports on (if empty, use default interfaces)

cvars.name: net_address_ipv6
cvars.description: network address to open ipv6 ports on (if empty, use default interfaces)

cvars.name: net_burstreserve
cvars.description: how much of the burst time to reserve for packet size spikes

cvars.name: net_challengefloodblockingtimeout
cvars.description: when a challenge packet is received, it will block all future challenge packets from that IP address for this many seconds (cuts down on challenge floods). DarkPlaces clients retry once per second, so this should be <= 1. Failure here may lead to connect attempts failing.

cvars.name: net_connectfloodblockingtimeout
cvars.description: when a connection packet is received, it will block all future connect packets from that IP address for this many seconds (cuts down on connect floods). Note that this does not include retries from the same IP; these are handled earlier and let in.

cvars.name: net_connecttimeout
cvars.description: after requesting a connection, the client must reply within this many seconds or be dropped (cuts down on connect floods). Must be above 10 seconds.

cvars.name: net_getstatusfloodblockingtimeout
cvars.description: when a getstatus packet is received, it will block all future getstatus packets from that IP address for this many seconds (cuts down on getstatus floods). DarkPlaces retries every 4 seconds, and qstat retries once per second, so this should be <= 1. Failure here may lead to server not showing up in the server list.

cvars.name: net_messagetimeout
cvars.description: drops players who have not sent any packets for this many seconds

cvars.name: net_slist_favorites
cvars.description: contains a list of IP addresses and ports to always query explicitly

cvars.name: net_slist_maxtries
cvars.description: how many times to ask the same server for information (more times gives better ping reports but takes longer)

cvars.name: net_slist_pause
cvars.description: when set to 1, the server list won't update until it is set back to 0

cvars.name: net_slist_queriesperframe
cvars.description: maximum number of server information requests to send each rendered frame (guards against low framerates causing problems)

cvars.name: net_slist_queriespersecond
cvars.description: how many server information requests to send per second

cvars.name: net_slist_timeout
cvars.description: how long to listen for a server information response before giving up

cvars.name: net_sourceaddresscheck
cvars.description: compare the source IP address for replies (more secure, may break some bad multihoming setups

cvars.name: net_test
cvars.description: internal development use only, leave it alone (usually does nothing anyway)

cvars.name: net_tos_dscp
cvars.description: DiffServ Codepoint for network sockets (may need game restart to apply)

cvars.name: net_usesizelimit
cvars.description: use packet size limiting (0: never, 1: in non-CSQC mode, 2: always)

cvars.name: nextmap
cvars.description: override the maplist when switching to the next map

cvars.name: noaim
cvars.description: QW option to disable vertical autoaim

cvars.name: noexit
cvars.description: kills anyone attempting to use an exit

cvars.name: nomonsters
cvars.description: unused cvar in quake, can be used by mods
