cvars.name: notification_allow_chatboxprint
cvars.description: Allow INFO notifications to be printed to chat box 0 = do not allow, 1 = allow only if allowed by individual notification_INFO* cvars, 2 = force all INFO notifications to be printed to the chatbox

cvars.name: notification_debug
cvars.description: Print extra debug information on all notification function calls (Requires -DNOTIFICATIONS_DEBUG flag to be enabled on QCSRC compilation)... 0 = disabled, 1 = dprint, 2 = print

cvars.name: notification_errors_are_fatal
cvars.description: If a notification fails upon initialization, cause a Host_Error to stop the program

cvars.name: notification_item_centerprinttime
cvars.description: How long to show item information centerprint messages (like 'You got the Electro' or such)

cvars.name: notification_lifetime_mapload
cvars.description: Amount of time that notification entities last immediately at mapload (in seconds) to help prevent notifications from being lost on early init (like gamestart countdown)

cvars.name: notification_lifetime_runtime
cvars.description: Amount of time that notification entities last on the server during runtime (In seconds)

cvars.name: notification_server_allows_location
cvars.description: Server side cvar for allowing death messages to show location information too

cvars.name: notification_show_location
cvars.description: Append location information to MSG_INFO death/kill messages

cvars.name: notification_show_location_string
cvars.description: Replacement string piped into sprintf, so you can do different messages like this: ' at the %s' or ' (near %s)'

cvars.name: notification_show_sprees
cvars.description: Print information about sprees in death/kill messages

cvars.name: notification_show_sprees_center
cvars.description: Show spree information in MSG_CENTER messages... 0 = off, 1 = target (but only for first victim) and attacker

cvars.name: notification_show_sprees_center_specialonly
cvars.description: Don't show spree information in MSG_CENTER messages if it isn't an achievement

cvars.name: notification_show_sprees_info
cvars.description: Show spree information in MSG_INFO messages... 0 = off, 1 = target only, 2 = attacker only, 3 = target and attacker

cvars.name: notification_show_sprees_info_newline
cvars.description: Show attacker spree information for MSG_INFO messages on a separate line than the death notification itself

cvars.name: notification_show_sprees_info_specialonly
cvars.description: Don't show attacker spree information in MSG_INFO messages if it isn't an achievement

cvars.name: pausable
cvars.description: allow players to pause or not (otherwise, only the server admin can)

cvars.name: physics_ode
cvars.description: run ODE physics (VERY experimental and potentially buggy)

cvars.name: physics_ode_allowconvex
cvars.description: allow usage of Convex Hull primitive type on trimeshes that have custom 'collisionconvex' mesh. If disabled, trimesh primitive type are used.

cvars.name: physics_ode_autodisable
cvars.description: automatic disabling of objects which dont move for long period of time, makes object stacking a lot faster

cvars.name: physics_ode_autodisable_steps
cvars.description: how many steps object should be dormant to be autodisabled

cvars.name: physics_ode_autodisable_threshold_angular
cvars.description: body will be disabled if it's angular move below this value

cvars.name: physics_ode_autodisable_threshold_linear
cvars.description: body will be disabled if it's linear move below this value

cvars.name: physics_ode_autodisable_threshold_samples
cvars.description: average threshold with this number of samples

cvars.name: physics_ode_autodisable_time
cvars.description: how many seconds object should be dormant to be autodisabled

cvars.name: physics_ode_constantstep
cvars.description: use constant step instead of variable step which tends to increase stability, if set to 1 uses sys_ticrate, instead uses it's own value

cvars.name: physics_ode_contact_cfm
cvars.description: contact solver cfm parameter - Constraint Force Mixing (see ODE User Guide)

cvars.name: physics_ode_contact_erp
cvars.description: contact solver erp parameter - Error Restitution Percent (see ODE User Guide)

cvars.name: physics_ode_contact_maxpoints
cvars.description: maximal number of contact points between 2 objects, higher = stable (and slower), can be up to 32

cvars.name: physics_ode_contact_mu
cvars.description: contact solver mu parameter - friction pyramid approximation 1 (see ODE User Guide)

cvars.name: physics_ode_contactsurfacelayer
cvars.description: allows objects to overlap this many units to reduce jitter

cvars.name: physics_ode_iterationsperframe
cvars.description: divisor for time step, runs multiple physics steps per frame

cvars.name: physics_ode_movelimit
cvars.description: clamp velocity if a single move would exceed this percentage of object thickness, to prevent flying through walls, be aware that behavior depends of step type

cvars.name: physics_ode_quadtree_depth
cvars.description: desired subdivision level of quadtree culling space

cvars.name: physics_ode_spinlimit
cvars.description: reset spin velocity if it gets too large

cvars.name: physics_ode_trick_fixnan
cvars.description: engine trick that checks and fixes NaN velocity/origin/angles on objects, a value of 2 makes console prints on each fix

cvars.name: physics_ode_world_cfm
cvars.description: world solver cfm parameter - Constraint Force Mixing (see ODE User Guide); not touched when -1

cvars.name: physics_ode_world_damping
cvars.description: enabled damping scale (see ODE User Guide), this scales all damping values, be aware that behavior depends of step type

cvars.name: physics_ode_world_damping_angular
cvars.description: world angular damping scale (see ODE User Guide); use defaults when set to -1

cvars.name: physics_ode_world_damping_angular_threshold
cvars.description: world angular damping threshold (see ODE User Guide); use defaults when set to -1

cvars.name: physics_ode_world_damping_linear
cvars.description: world linear damping scale (see ODE User Guide); use defaults when set to -1

cvars.name: physics_ode_world_damping_linear_threshold
cvars.description: world linear damping threshold (see ODE User Guide); use defaults when set to -1

cvars.name: physics_ode_world_erp
cvars.description: world solver erp parameter - Error Restitution Percent (see ODE User Guide); use defaults when set to -1

cvars.name: physics_ode_world_gravitymod
cvars.description: multiplies gravity got from sv_gravity, this may be needed to tweak if strong damping is used

cvars.name: port
cvars.description: server port for players to connect to

cvars.name: posview_verbose
cvars.description: also print posview on save so that a previously saved posview can be restored by copying it from the OS console log and pasted to the Xonotic console

cvars.name: pr_checkextension
cvars.description: indicates to QuakeC that the standard quakec extensions system is available (if 0, quakec should not attempt to use extensions)

cvars.name: prvm_backtraceforwarnings
cvars.description: print a backtrace for warnings too

cvars.name: prvm_breakpointdump
cvars.description: write a savegame on breakpoint to breakpoint-server.dmp

cvars.name: prvm_coverage
cvars.description: report and count coverage events (1: per-function, 2: coverage() builtin, 4: per-statement)

cvars.name: prvm_errordump
cvars.description: write a savegame on crash to crash-server.dmp

cvars.name: prvm_language
cvars.description: when set, loads PROGSFILE.LANGUAGENAME.po and common.LANGUAGENAME.po for string translations; when set to dump, PROGSFILE.pot is written from the strings in the progs

cvars.name: prvm_leaktest
cvars.description: try to detect memory leaks in strings or entities

cvars.name: prvm_leaktest_follow_targetname
cvars.description: if set, target/targetname links are considered when leak testing; this should normally not be required, as entities created during startup - e.g. info_notnull - are never considered leaky

cvars.name: prvm_leaktest_ignore_classnames
cvars.description: classnames of entities to NOT leak check because they are found by find(world, classname, ...) but are actually spawned by QC code (NOT map entities)

cvars.name: prvm_reuseedicts_neverinsameframe
cvars.description: never allows re-use of freed entity slots during same frame

cvars.name: prvm_reuseedicts_startuptime
cvars.description: allows immediate re-use of freed entity slots during start of new level (value in seconds)

cvars.name: prvm_statementprofiling
cvars.description: counts how many times each QuakeC statement has been executed, these counts are displayed in prvm_printfunction output (if enabled)

cvars.name: prvm_timeprofiling
cvars.description: counts how long each function has been executed, these counts are displayed in prvm_profile output (if enabled)

cvars.name: prvm_traceqc
cvars.description: prints every QuakeC statement as it is executed (only for really thorough debugging!)

cvars.name: quit_and_redirect
cvars.description: set to an IP to redirect all players at the end of the match to another server. Set to "self" to let all players reconnect at the end of the match (use it to make seamless engine updates)

cvars.name: quit_and_redirect_timer
cvars.description: set to number of seconds after quit before performing the connect operation of quit_and_redirect

cvars.name: quit_when_empty
cvars.description: set to 1, then the server exits when the next level would start but is empty

cvars.name: r_enableshadowvolumes
cvars.description: Enables use of Stencil Shadow Volume shadowing methods, saves some memory if turned off

cvars.name: r_fixtrans_auto
cvars.description: automatically fixtrans textures (when set to 2, it also saves the fixed versions to a fixtrans directory)

cvars.name: r_labelsprites_roundtopixels
cvars.description: try to make label sprites sharper by rounding their size to 0.5x or 1x and by rounding their position to whole pixels if possible

cvars.name: r_labelsprites_scale
cvars.description: global scale to apply to label sprites before conversion to HUD coordinates

cvars.name: r_mipnormalmaps
cvars.description: mipmaps normalmaps (turning it off looks sharper but may have aliasing)

cvars.name: r_mipskins
cvars.description: mipmaps model skins so they render faster in the distance and do not display noise artifacts, can cause discoloration of skins if they contain undesirable border colors

cvars.name: r_mipsprites
cvars.description: mipmaps sprites so they render faster in the distance and do not display noise artifacts

cvars.name: r_nosurftextures
cvars.description: pretends there was no texture lump found in the q1bsp/hlbsp loading (useful for debugging this rare case)

cvars.name: r_novis
cvars.description: draws whole level, see also sv_cullentities_pvs 0

cvars.name: r_overheadsprites_perspective
cvars.description: fake perspective effect for SPR_OVERHEAD sprites

cvars.name: r_overheadsprites_pushback
cvars.description: how far to pull the SPR_OVERHEAD sprites toward the eye (used to avoid intersections with 3D models)

cvars.name: r_overheadsprites_scalex
cvars.description: additional scale for overhead sprites for x axis

cvars.name: r_overheadsprites_scaley
cvars.description: additional scale for overhead sprites for y axis

cvars.name: r_skeletal_debugbone
cvars.description: development cvar for testing skeletal model code

cvars.name: r_skeletal_debugbonecomponent
cvars.description: development cvar for testing skeletal model code

cvars.name: r_skeletal_debugbonevalue
cvars.description: development cvar for testing skeletal model code

cvars.name: r_skeletal_debugtranslatex
cvars.description: development cvar for testing skeletal model code

cvars.name: r_skeletal_debugtranslatey
cvars.description: development cvar for testing skeletal model code

cvars.name: r_skeletal_debugtranslatez
cvars.description: development cvar for testing skeletal model code

cvars.name: r_skeletal_use_sse
cvars.description: use SSE for skeletal model animation

cvars.name: r_subdivisions_collision_maxtess
cvars.description: maximum number of subdivisions (prevents curves beyond a certain detail level, limits smoothing)

cvars.name: r_subdivisions_collision_maxvertices
cvars.description: maximum vertices allowed per subdivided curve

cvars.name: r_subdivisions_collision_mintess
cvars.description: minimum number of subdivisions (values above 0 will smooth curves that don't need it)

cvars.name: r_subdivisions_collision_tolerance
cvars.description: maximum error tolerance on curve subdivision for collision purposes (usually a larger error tolerance than for rendering)

cvars.name: r_subdivisions_maxtess
cvars.description: maximum number of subdivisions (prevents curves beyond a certain detail level, limits smoothing)

cvars.name: r_subdivisions_maxvertices
cvars.description: maximum vertices allowed per subdivided curve

cvars.name: r_subdivisions_mintess
cvars.description: minimum number of subdivisions (values above 0 will smooth curves that don't need it)

cvars.name: r_subdivisions_tolerance
cvars.description: maximum error tolerance on curve subdivision for rendering purposes (in other words, the curves will be given as many polygons as necessary to represent curves at this quality)

cvars.name: r_texture_jpeg_fastpicmip
cvars.description: perform gl_picmip during decompression for JPEG files (faster)

cvars.name: r_track_sprites
cvars.description: track SPR_LABEL* sprites by putting them as indicator at the screen border to rotate to

cvars.name: r_track_sprites_flags
cvars.description: 1: Rotate sprites accordingly, 2: Make it a continuous rotation

cvars.name: rcon_address
cvars.description: server address to send rcon commands to (when not connected to a server)

cvars.name: rcon_password
cvars.description: password to authenticate rcon commands; NOTE: changing rcon_secure clears rcon_password, so set rcon_secure always before rcon_password; may be set to a string of the form user1:pass1 user2:pass2 user3:pass3 to allow multiple user accounts - the client then has to specify ONE of these combinations

cvars.name: rcon_restricted_commands
cvars.default: restart fraglimit chmap gotomap nextmap endmatch reducematchtime extendmatchtime allready resetmatch kick cointoss movetoauto shuffleteams bots nobots movetored movetoblue movetoyellow movetopink movetospec kickban "sv_cmd bans" "sv_cmd unban *" status "sv_cmd teamstatus"
cvars.description: allowed commands for rcon when the restricted mode password was used

cvars.name: rcon_restricted_password
cvars.description: password to authenticate rcon commands in restricted mode; may be set to a string of the form user1:pass1 user2:pass2 user3:pass3 to allow multiple user accounts - the client then has to specify ONE of these combinations

cvars.name: rcon_secure
cvars.description: force secure rcon authentication (1 = time based, 2 = challenge based); NOTE: changing rcon_secure clears rcon_password, so set rcon_secure always before rcon_password

cvars.name: rcon_secure_challengetimeout
cvars.description: challenge-based secure rcon: time out requests if no challenge came within this time interval

cvars.name: rcon_secure_maxdiff
cvars.description: maximum time difference between rcon request and server system clock (to protect against replay attack)

cvars.name: registered
cvars.description: indicates if this is running registered quake (whether gfx/pop.lmp was found)

cvars.name: rescan_pending
cvars.description: set to 1 to schedule a fs_rescan at the end of this match

cvars.name: rpn_linear_to_sRGB
cvars.default: dup 1.0 2.4 div pow 1.055 mul 0.055 sub exch 12.92 mul dup 0.04045 ge when

cvars.name: rpn_sRGB_to_linear
cvars.default: dup 0.055 add 1.055 div 2.4 pow exch 12.92 div dup 0.0031308 gt when

cvars.name: samelevel
cvars.description: repeats same level if level ends (due to timelimit or someone hitting an exit)

cvars.name: saved1
cvars.description: unused cvar in quake that is saved to config.cfg on exit, can be used by mods

cvars.name: saved2
cvars.description: unused cvar in quake that is saved to config.cfg on exit, can be used by mods

cvars.name: saved3
cvars.description: unused cvar in quake that is saved to config.cfg on exit, can be used by mods

cvars.name: saved4
cvars.description: unused cvar in quake that is saved to config.cfg on exit, can be used by mods

cvars.name: savedgamecfg
cvars.description: unused cvar in quake that is saved to config.cfg on exit, can be used by mods

cvars.name: sbar_info_pos
cvars.description: Y-axis distance from lower right corner for engine info prints

cvars.name: scoreboard_accuracy
cvars.description: show weapon accuracy stats panel on scoreboard; colors can be configured with accuracy_color* cvars

cvars.name: scoreboard_accuracy_doublerows
cvars.description: use two rows instead of one

cvars.name: scoreboard_accuracy_nocolors
cvars.description: don't use colors displaying accuracy stats

cvars.name: scoreboard_alpha_name
cvars.description: alpha of player text in scoreboard list other than self

cvars.name: scoreboard_alpha_name_self
cvars.description: alpha of player text in scoreboard list of self

cvars.name: scoreboard_bg_scale
cvars.description: scale for the tiled scoreboard background

cvars.name: scoreboard_color_bg_b
cvars.description: blue color component of the scoreboard background

cvars.name: scoreboard_color_bg_g
cvars.description: green color component of the scoreboard background

cvars.name: scoreboard_color_bg_r
cvars.description: red color component of the scoreboard background

cvars.name: scoreboard_color_bg_team
cvars.description: team color multiplier of the scoreboard background

cvars.name: scoreboard_dynamichud
cvars.description: apply the dynamic hud effects to the scoreboard

cvars.name: scoreboard_fadeinspeed
cvars.description: speed at which scoreboard fades in, higher is faster (0 = instant)

cvars.name: scoreboard_fadeoutspeed
cvars.description: speed at which scoreboard fades out, higher is faster (0 = instant)

cvars.name: scoreboard_highlight
cvars.description: enable highlighting for rows and columns in the scoreboard

cvars.name: scoreboard_offset_left
cvars.description: how far (by percent) the scoreboard is offset from the left screen edge

cvars.name: scoreboard_offset_right
cvars.description: how far (by percent) the scoreboard is offset from the right screen edge

cvars.name: scoreboard_offset_vertical
cvars.description: how far (by percent) the scoreboard is offset from the top and bottom of the screen

cvars.name: scoreboard_respawntime_decimals
cvars.description: decimal places to show for the respawntime countdown display on the scoreboard

cvars.name: scr_screenshot_name
cvars.description: prefix name for saved screenshots (changes based on -game commandline, as well as which game mode is running; the date is encoded using strftime escapes)

cvars.name: scratch1
cvars.description: unused cvar in quake, can be used by mods

cvars.name: scratch2
cvars.description: unused cvar in quake, can be used by mods

cvars.name: scratch3
cvars.description: unused cvar in quake, can be used by mods

cvars.name: scratch4
cvars.description: unused cvar in quake, can be used by mods

cvars.name: sessionid
cvars.description: ID of the current session (use the -sessionid parameter to set it); this is always either empty or begins with a dot (.)

cvars.name: skill
cvars.description: difficulty level of game, affects monster layouts in levels, 0 = easy, 1 = normal, 2 = hard, 3 = nightmare (same layout as hard but monsters fire twice)

cvars.name: skill_auto
cvars.description: when 1, "skill" gets adjusted to match the best player on the map

cvars.name: slowmo
cvars.description: controls game speed, 0.5 is half speed, 2 is double speed

cvars.name: spawn_debug
cvars.description: use all spawns one by one, then abort, to verify all spawnpoints

cvars.name: sv_accelerate
cvars.description: rate at which a player accelerates to sv_maxspeed

cvars.name: sv_accuracy_data_send
cvars.description: 1 send weapon accuracy data statistics and improved score info to all the clients at the end of the match, depends on cl_accuracy_data_receive, 0 send the current 'player has won' to all the clients

cvars.name: sv_accuracy_data_share
cvars.description: 1 send weapon accuracy data statistics to spectating clients, depends on cl_accuracy_data_share

cvars.name: sv_adminnick
cvars.description: nick name to use for admin messages instead of host name

cvars.name: sv_aim
cvars.description: maximum cosine angle for quake's vertical autoaim, a value above 1 completely disables the autoaim, quake used 0.93

cvars.name: sv_airaccel_qw
cvars.description: ratio of QW-style air control as opposed to simple acceleration; when < 0, the speed is clamped against the maximum allowed forward speed after the move

cvars.name: sv_airaccel_qw_stretchfactor
cvars.description: when set, the maximum acceleration increase the player may get compared to forward-acceleration when strafejumping

cvars.name: sv_airaccel_sideways_friction
cvars.description: anti-sideways movement stabilization (reduces speed gain when zigzagging); when < 0, only so much friction is applied that braking (by accelerating backwards) cannot be stronger

cvars.name: sv_airaccelerate
cvars.description: rate at which a player accelerates to sv_maxairspeed while in the air, if less than 0 the sv_accelerate variable is used instead

cvars.name: sv_aircontrol_backwards
cvars.description: apply forward aircontrol options to backward movement

cvars.name: sv_aircontrol_penalty
cvars.description: deceleration while using CPMA-style air control

cvars.name: sv_aircontrol_sidewards
cvars.description: apply forward aircontrol options to sideward movement

cvars.name: sv_airspeedlimit_nonqw
cvars.description: when set, this is a soft speed limit while in air when using airaccel_qw not equal to 1

cvars.name: sv_airstopaccelerate
cvars.description: when set, replacement for sv_airaccelerate when moving backwards

cvars.name: sv_airstrafeaccel_qw
cvars.description: when set, replacement for sv_airaccel_qw when just strafing

cvars.name: sv_airstrafeaccelerate
cvars.description: when set, replacement for sv_airaccelerate when just strafing

cvars.name: sv_allow_fullbright
cvars.description: when set, clients may use r_fullbright on this server without getting a night vision effect overlay

cvars.name: sv_allowdownloads
cvars.description: whether to allow clients to download files from the server (does not affect http downloads)

cvars.name: sv_allowdownloads_archive
cvars.description: whether to allow downloads of archives (pak/pk3)

cvars.name: sv_allowdownloads_config
cvars.description: whether to allow downloads of config files (cfg)

cvars.name: sv_allowdownloads_dlcache
cvars.description: whether to allow downloads of dlcache files (dlcache/)

cvars.name: sv_allowdownloads_inarchive
cvars.description: whether to allow downloads from archives (pak/pk3)

cvars.name: sv_areadebug
cvars.description: disables physics culling for debugging purposes (only for development)

cvars.name: sv_areagrid_mingridsize
cvars.description: minimum areagrid cell size, smaller values work better for lots of small objects, higher values for large objects

cvars.name: sv_autodemo_perclient
cvars.description: set to 1 to enable autorecorded per-client demos (they'll start to record at the beginning of a match); set it to 2 to also record client->server packets (for debugging)

cvars.name: sv_autodemo_perclient_discardable
cvars.description: Allow game code to decide whether a demo should be kept or discarded.

cvars.name: sv_autodemo_perclient_nameformat
cvars.description: The format of the sv_autodemo_perclient filename, followed by the map name, the client number and the IP address + port number, separated by underscores (the date is encoded using strftime escapes)

cvars.name: sv_autopause
cvars.description: Single player or listen server: pause while all clients have the menu, console or chat open. Dedicated server: pause after starting a map if the server is empty and unpause when the first player joins the empty server.

cvars.name: sv_autoscreenshot
cvars.description: if set to 1, the server forces all clients to create a local screenshot once the map ended

cvars.name: sv_cheats
cvars.description: enables cheat commands in any game, and cheat impulses in dpmod

cvars.name: sv_checkforpacketsduringsleep
cvars.description: uses select() function to wait between frames which can be interrupted by packets being received, instead of Sleep()/usleep()/SDL_Sleep() functions which do not check for packets

cvars.name: sv_clientcommand_antispam_count
cvars.description: Amount of commands considered spam before commands are rejected.

cvars.name: sv_clientcommand_antispam_time
cvars.description: Amount of seconds after a command before another command can be called again without being considered spam. (Use -1 for no antispam limit)

cvars.name: sv_clmovement_enable
cvars.description: whether to allow clients to use cl_movement prediction, which can cause choppy movement on the server which may annoy other players

cvars.name: sv_clmovement_inputtimeout
cvars.description: when a client does not send input for this many seconds, force them to move anyway (unlike QuakeWorld)

cvars.name: sv_clmovement_minping
cvars.description: if client ping is below this time in milliseconds, then their ability to use cl_movement prediction is disabled for a while (as they don't need it)

cvars.name: sv_clmovement_minping_disabletime
cvars.description: when client falls below minping, disable their prediction for this many milliseconds (should be at least 1000 or else their prediction may turn on/off frequently)

cvars.name: sv_clones
cvars.description: number of clones a player may make (reset by the "kill" command)

cvars.name: sv_cullentities_nevercullbmodels
cvars.description: if enabled the clients are always notified of moving doors and lifts and other submodels of world (warning: eats a lot of network bandwidth on some levels!)

cvars.name: sv_cullentities_pvs
cvars.description: fast but loose culling of hidden entities

cvars.name: sv_cullentities_stats
cvars.description: displays stats on network entities culled by various methods for each client

cvars.name: sv_cullentities_trace
cvars.description: somewhat slow but very tight culling of hidden entities, minimizes network traffic and makes wallhack cheats useless

cvars.name: sv_cullentities_trace_delay
cvars.description: number of seconds until the entity gets actually culled

cvars.name: sv_cullentities_trace_delay_players
cvars.description: number of seconds until the entity gets actually culled if it is a player entity

cvars.name: sv_cullentities_trace_entityocclusion
cvars.description: also check if doors and other bsp models are in the way

cvars.name: sv_cullentities_trace_eyejitter
cvars.description: jitter the eye by this much for each trace

cvars.name: sv_cullentities_trace_prediction
cvars.description: also trace from the predicted player position

cvars.name: sv_cullentities_trace_prediction_time
cvars.description: how many seconds of prediction to use

cvars.name: sv_cullentities_trace_samples
cvars.description: number of samples to test for entity culling

cvars.name: sv_cullentities_trace_samples_extra
cvars.description: number of samples to test for entity culling when the entity affects its surroundings by e.g. dlight

cvars.name: sv_cullentities_trace_samples_players
cvars.description: number of samples to test for entity culling when the entity is a player entity

cvars.name: sv_curl_maxspeed
cvars.description: maximum download speed for clients downloading from sv_curl_defaulturl (KiB/s)

cvars.name: sv_curl_serverpackages
cvars.description: list of required files for the clients, separated by spaces

cvars.name: sv_curl_serverpackages_auto
cvars.description: automatically add packs with *.serverpackage files to sv_curl_serverpackages

cvars.name: sv_damagetext
cvars.description: <= 0: disabled, >= 1: visible to spectators, >= 2: visible to attacker, >= 3: all players see everyone's damage

cvars.name: sv_db_saveasdump
cvars.description: write server.db in dump format (loads slower, easier to read/parse)

cvars.name: sv_debugmove
cvars.description: disables collision detection optimizations for debugging purposes

cvars.name: sv_defaultcharacter
cvars.description: master switch, if set to 1 the further configuration for replacing all player models, skins and colors is taken from the sv_defaultplayermodel, sv_defaultplayerskin and sv_defaultplayercolors variables

cvars.name: sv_defaultcharacterskin
cvars.description: if set to 1 the further configuration for replacing all skins is taken from the sv_defaultplayerskin variables

cvars.name: sv_defaultplayercolors
cvars.description: set to 16*shirt+pants to force a color, note: it does NOT depend on defaultcharacter! Set to "" to disable

cvars.name: sv_defaultplayermodel
cvars.description: default model selection, only works if sv_defaultcharacter is set to 1; you may append a :<skinnumber> suffix to model names; you can specify multiple, separated by space, and a random one will be chosen

cvars.name: sv_defaultplayerskin
cvars.description: each model has 1 or more skins (combination of model and skin = character), set which skin of the model you wish the default character to have, only works if sv_defaultcharacter is set to 1; can be overridden by :<skinnumber> suffix in sv_defaultplayermodel

cvars.name: sv_defaultplayerskin_blue
cvars.description: skin to use on the blue team, set to 0 to instead use sv_defaultplayerskin

cvars.name: sv_defaultplayerskin_pink
cvars.description: skin to use on the pink team, set to 0 to instead use sv_defaultplayerskin

cvars.name: sv_defaultplayerskin_red
cvars.description: skin to use on the red team, set to 0 to instead use sv_defaultplayerskin

cvars.name: sv_defaultplayerskin_yellow
cvars.description: skin to use on the yellow team, set to 0 to instead use sv_defaultplayerskin

cvars.name: sv_disablenotify
cvars.description: suppress broadcast prints when certain cvars are changed (CVAR_NOTIFY flag in engine code)

cvars.name: sv_dodging_air_maxspeed
cvars.description: maximum speed a player can be moving at before they dodge again when air dodging is enabled

cvars.name: sv_dodging_clientselect
cvars.description: allow clients to opt-in to dodging movement with the cl_dodging cvar, dodging will be off for clients by default with this enabled

cvars.name: sv_dodging_delay
cvars.description: determines how long a player has to wait to be able to dodge again after dodging

cvars.name: sv_dodging_frozen
cvars.description: allow dodging while frozen (requires g_dodging to be enabled)

cvars.name: sv_dodging_height_threshold
cvars.description: the maximum height above ground where to allow dodging

cvars.name: sv_dodging_horiz_force_fastest
cvars.description: the horizontal velocity of the dodge when current velocity is >= sv_dodging_horiz_speed_max, values between min and max are linearly scaled

cvars.name: sv_dodging_horiz_force_frozen
cvars.description: the horizontal velocity of the dodge while frozen

cvars.name: sv_dodging_horiz_force_slowest
cvars.description: the horizontal velocity of the dodge when current velocity is <= sv_dodging_horiz_speed_min, values between min and max are linearly scaled

cvars.name: sv_dodging_horiz_speed_max
cvars.description: the upper bound of current velocity for force scaling

cvars.name: sv_dodging_horiz_speed_min
cvars.description: the lower bound of current velocity for force scaling

cvars.name: sv_dodging_maxspeed
cvars.description: maximum speed a player can be moving at to use the standard dodging from an (almost) standstill

cvars.name: sv_dodging_ramp_time
cvars.description: a ramp so that the horizontal part of the dodge is added smoothly (seconds)

cvars.name: sv_dodging_sound
cvars.description: if 1 dodging makes a sound. if 0 dodging is silent

cvars.name: sv_dodging_up_speed
cvars.description: the jump velocity of the dodge

cvars.name: sv_dodging_wall_distance_threshold
cvars.description: the maximum distance from a wall that still allows dodging

cvars.name: sv_doors_always_open
cvars.description: If set to 1 don't close doors which after they were open

cvars.name: sv_echobprint
cvars.description: prints gamecode bprint() calls to server console

cvars.name: sv_entpatch
cvars.description: enables loading of .ent files to override entities in the bsp (for example Threewave CTF server pack contains .ent patch files enabling play of CTF on id1 maps)

cvars.name: sv_eventlog_console
cvars.description: print event log entries to the dedicated console as well

cvars.name: sv_eventlog_files
cvars.description: save the event log to individual files

cvars.name: sv_eventlog_files_counter
cvars.description: internal counter cvar, do not modify

cvars.name: sv_eventlog_files_nameprefix
cvars.description: prefix of individual log file names

cvars.name: sv_eventlog_files_namesuffix
cvars.description: suffix of individual log file names

cvars.name: sv_eventlog_files_timestamps
cvars.description: include timestamps in the log file names

cvars.name: sv_eventlog_ipv6_delimiter
cvars.description: use a _ delimiter for IPV6 IPs, so that they can be easily detected in scripts

cvars.name: sv_fixedframeratesingleplayer
cvars.description: allows you to use server-style timing system in singleplayer (don't run faster than sys_ticrate)

cvars.name: sv_foginterval
cvars.description: force enable fog in regular intervals

cvars.name: sv_forbid_pickuptimer
cvars.description: when set, clients won't be able to see the time they picked up an item

cvars.name: sv_freezenonclients
cvars.description: freezes time, except for players, allowing you to walk around and take screenshots of explosions

cvars.name: sv_friction_on_land
cvars.description: movement friction applied for half a second upon landing on the ground

cvars.name: sv_friction_slick
cvars.description: movement friction while on slick surfaces

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_blowupfallenzombies
cvars.description: causes findradius to detect SOLID_NOT entities such as zombies and corpses on the floor, allowing splash damage to apply to them

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_consistentplayerprethink
cvars.description: improves fairness in multiplayer by running all PlayerPreThink functions (which fire weapons) before performing physics, then running all PlayerPostThink functions

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_delayprojectiles
cvars.description: causes entities to not move on the same frame they are spawned, meaning that projectiles wait until the next frame to perform their first move, giving proper interpolation and rocket trails, but making weapons harder to use at low framerates

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_downtracesupportsongroundflag
cvars.description: prevents very short moves from clearing onground (which may make the player stick to the floor at high netfps)

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_droptofloorstartsolid
cvars.description: prevents items and monsters that start in a solid area from falling out of the level (makes droptofloor treat trace_startsolid as an acceptable outcome)

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_droptofloorstartsolid_nudgetocorrect
cvars.description: tries to nudge stuck items and monsters out of walls before droptofloor is performed

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_easierwaterjump
cvars.description: changes water jumping to make it easier to get out of water (exactly like in QuakeWorld)

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_findradiusdistancetobox
cvars.description: causes findradius to check the distance to the corner of a box rather than the center of the box, makes findradius detect bmodels such as very large doors that would otherwise be unaffected by splash damage

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_fixedcheckwatertransition
cvars.description: fix two very stupid bugs in SV_CheckWaterTransition when watertype is CONTENTS_EMPTY (the bugs causes waterlevel to be 1 on first frame, -1 on second frame - the fix makes it 0 on both frames)

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_gravityunaffectedbyticrate
cvars.description: fix some ticrate issues in physics.

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_grenadebouncedownslopes
cvars.description: prevents MOVETYPE_BOUNCE (grenades) from getting stuck when fired down a downward sloping surface

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_multiplethinksperframe
cvars.description: allows entities to think more often than the server framerate, primarily useful for very high fire rate weapons

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_noairborncorpse
cvars.description: causes entities (corpses, items, etc) sitting ontop of moving entities (players) to fall when the moving entity (player) is no longer supporting them

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_noairborncorpse_allowsuspendeditems
cvars.description: causes entities sitting ontop of objects that are instantaneously remove to float in midair (special hack to allow a common level design trick for floating items)

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_nogravityonground
cvars.description: turn off gravity when on ground (to get rid of sliding)

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_nostepmoveonsteepslopes
cvars.description: crude fix which prevents MOVETYPE_STEP (not swimming or flying) to move on slopes whose angle is bigger than 45 degree

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_nudgeoutofsolid
cvars.description: attempts to fix physics errors (where an object ended up in solid for some reason)

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_nudgeoutofsolid_separation
cvars.description: keep objects this distance apart to prevent collision issues on seams

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_q1bsptracelinereportstexture
cvars.description: enables mods to get accurate trace_texture results on q1bsp by using a surface-hitting traceline implementation rather than the standard solidbsp method, q3bsp always reports texture accurately

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_setmodelrealbox
cvars.description: fixes a bug in Quake that made setmodel always set the entity box to ('-16 -16 -16', '16 16 16') rather than properly checking the model box, breaks some poorly coded mods

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_slidemoveprojectiles
cvars.description: allows MOVETYPE_FLY/FLYMISSILE/TOSS/BOUNCE/BOUNCEMISSILE entities to finish their move in a frame even if they hit something, fixes 'gravity accumulation' bug for grenades on steep slopes

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_stepdown
cvars.description: attempts to step down stairs, not just up them (prevents the familiar thud..thud..thud.. when running down stairs and slopes)

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_stepdown_maxspeed
cvars.description: maximum speed walking entities can be moving for stepping down to apply

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_stepmultipletimes
cvars.description: applies step-up onto a ledge more than once in a single frame, when running quickly up stairs

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_swiminbmodels
cvars.description: causes pointcontents (used to determine if you are in a liquid) to check bmodel entities as well as the world model, so you can swim around in (possibly moving) water bmodel entities

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_unstickentities
cvars.description: hack to check if entities are crossing world collision hull and try to move them to the right position

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_unstickplayers
cvars.description: big hack to try and fix the rare case of MOVETYPE_WALK entities getting stuck in the world clipping hull.

cvars.name: sv_gameplayfix_upwardvelocityclearsongroundflag
cvars.description: prevents monsters, items, and most other objects from being stuck to the floor when pushed around by damage, and other situations in mods

cvars.name: sv_gentle
cvars.description: force gentle mode for everyone, also remove references to acts of killing from the messages

cvars.name: sv_gibhealth
cvars.description: Minus health a dead body must have in order to get gibbed

cvars.name: sv_gravity
cvars.description: how fast you fall (512 = roughly earth gravity)

cvars.name: sv_heartbeatperiod
cvars.description: how often to send heartbeat in seconds (only used if sv_public is 1)

cvars.name: sv_idealpitchscale
cvars.description: how much to look up/down slopes and stairs when not using freelook

cvars.name: sv_init_frame_count
cvars.description: number of frames to run to allow everything to settle before letting clients connect

cvars.name: sv_itemstime
cvars.description: enable networking of time left until respawn for items such as mega health/armor and powerups

cvars.name: sv_join_notices
cvars.description: special alerts to show joining players

cvars.name: sv_join_notices_time
cvars.description: how long the alert is shown on the player's screen

cvars.name: sv_jumpspeedcap_max
cvars.description: upper bound on the baseline velocity of a jump; final velocity will be <= (jumpheight * max + jumpheight)

cvars.name: sv_jumpspeedcap_max_disable_on_ramps
cvars.description: disable upper baseline velocity bound on ramps to preserve the old rampjump style

cvars.name: sv_jumpspeedcap_min
cvars.description: lower bound on the baseline velocity of a jump; final velocity will be >= (jumpheight * min + jumpheight)

cvars.name: sv_jumpstep
cvars.description: whether you can step up while jumping

cvars.name: sv_jumpvelocity
cvars.description: cvar that can be used by QuakeC code for jump velocity

cvars.name: sv_jumpvelocity_crouch
cvars.description: jump height while crouching, set to 0 to use regular jump height

cvars.name: sv_legacy_bbox_expand
cvars.description: before linking an entity to the area grid, decrease its mins and increase its maxs by '1 1 1', or '15 15 1' if it has flag FL_ITEM (this is the Quake/QuakeWorld behaviour); disable to make SVQC bboxes consistent with CSQC which never does this expansion

cvars.name: sv_mapchange_delay
cvars.description: delay by this many seconds after the match ends before showing selection screen or changing maps

cvars.name: sv_mapformat_is_quake2
cvars.description: indicates the current map is q2bsp format (useful to know because of different entity behaviors, .frame on submodels and other things)

cvars.name: sv_mapformat_is_quake3
cvars.description: indicates the current map is q2bsp format (useful to know because of different entity behaviors)

cvars.name: sv_maxairspeed
cvars.description: maximum speed a player can accelerate to when airborn (note that it is possible to completely stop by moving the opposite direction)

cvars.name: sv_maxairstrafespeed
cvars.description: when set, replacement for sv_maxairspeed when just strafing

cvars.name: sv_maxidle
cvars.description: kick players idle for more than this amount of time in seconds

cvars.name: sv_maxidle_alsokickspectators
cvars.description: when sv_maxidle is > 0, kick idle spectators as well as players

cvars.name: sv_maxidle_minplayers
cvars.description: check for idlers only when there are at least this many players (only in dedicated servers)

cvars.name: sv_maxidle_playertospectator
cvars.description: move players idle for more than this amount of time in seconds to spectators (sv_maxidle timer starts again after sv_maxidle_playertospectator has moved a player to spectators)

cvars.name: sv_maxidle_slots
cvars.description: when not 0, only kick idlers when this many or less player slots are available

cvars.name: sv_maxrate
cvars.description: upper limit on client rate cvar, should reflect your network connection quality

cvars.name: sv_maxspeed
cvars.description: maximum speed a player can accelerate to when on ground (can be exceeded by tricks)

cvars.name: sv_maxvelocity
cvars.description: universal speed limit on all entities

cvars.name: sv_minigames_observer
cvars.description: Force minigame players to be observers. 0: don't move them to observer, 1: move them to observer, 2: force observer

cvars.name: sv_minigames_pong_ai_tolerance
cvars.description: Distance of the ball relative to the paddle size

cvars.name: sv_minigames_pong_ball_number
cvars.description: Number of balls to be played at once

cvars.name: sv_minigames_pong_ball_radius
cvars.description: Ball radius relative to the board size

cvars.name: sv_minigames_pong_ball_wait
cvars.description: Number of seconds between reset and throw

cvars.name: sv_minigames_pong_paddle_size
cvars.description: Paddle length relative to the board size

cvars.name: sv_motd
cvars.description: additional information to show on the welcome screen that greets joining players

cvars.name: sv_name_maxlength
cvars.description: max player name length (not counting color codes) allowed by the server

cvars.name: sv_namechangetimer
cvars.description: how often to allow name changes, in seconds (prevents people from using animated names and other tricks

cvars.name: sv_onlycsqcnetworking
cvars.description: disables legacy entity networking code for higher performance (except on clients, which can still be legacy)

cvars.name: sv_player_crouch_viewoffset
cvars.description: view offset of the player model when crouched

cvars.name: sv_player_viewoffset
cvars.description: view offset of the player model

cvars.name: sv_playerphysicsqc
cvars.description: enables QuakeC function to override player physics

cvars.name: sv_precacheplayermodels
cvars.description: preload all the player models at game start, to avoid delays during gameplay

cvars.name: sv_progs
cvars.description: selects which quakec progs.dat file to run

cvars.name: sv_protocolname
cvars.description: selects network protocol to host for (values include QUAKE, QUAKEDP, NEHAHRAMOVIE, DP1 and up)

cvars.name: sv_public
cvars.description: 1: advertises this server on the master server (so that players can find it in the server browser); 0: allow direct queries only; -1: do not respond to direct queries; -2: do not allow anyone to connect; -3: already block at getchallenge level

cvars.name: sv_public_rejectreason
cvars.description: Rejection reason for connects when sv_public is -2

cvars.name: sv_q3compat_changehitbox
cvars.description: use Q3 player hitbox dimensions and camera height on Q3 maps (maps with an entry in a .arena or .defi file)

cvars.name: sv_quickmenu_file
cvars.description: filename of a custom server's quickmenu that will be selectable from the default client's quickmenu. This file must be sent in a pk3 archive and should have an unique name (e.g. quickmenu-servername.txt) to prevent overriding existing quickmenus

cvars.name: sv_random_seed
cvars.description: random seed; when set, on every map start this random seed is used to initialize the random number generator. Don't touch it unless for benchmarking or debugging

cvars.name: sv_ratelimitlocalplayer
cvars.description: whether to apply rate limiting to the local player in a listen server (only useful for testing)

cvars.name: sv_ready_restart_after_countdown
cvars.description: reset players and map items after the countdown ended, instead of at the beginning of the countdown

cvars.name: sv_servermodelsonly
cvars.description: enable to prevent players from using playermodels that don't exist on the server

cvars.name: sv_show_entnum
cvars.description: Show the number and some info of the entity you're aiming at

cvars.name: sv_showfps
cvars.description: Show player's FPS counters in the scoreboard. This setting acts as a delay in seconds between updates. NOTE: this feature gathers performance telemetry, it may require consent from players on the server depending on your legislation

cvars.name: sv_shownames_cull_distance
cvars.description: distance after which to not send origin/health/armor of another player

cvars.name: sv_showspectators
cvars.description: Show who's spectating who in the player info panel when client has cl_showspectators on. 1: shouldn't be used on competitive servers, or when watching a suspected cheater. 2: only spectators can see the spectators list

cvars.name: sv_simple_items
cvars.description: allow or forbid client use of simple items

cvars.name: sv_slick_applygravity
cvars.description: apply a downward force while on slick surfaces to simulate slippery slopes

cvars.name: sv_sound_land
cvars.description: sound to play when MOVETYPE_STEP entity hits the ground at high speed (empty cvar disables the sound)

cvars.name: sv_sound_watersplash
cvars.description: sound to play when MOVETYPE_FLY/TOSS/BOUNCE/STEP entity enters or leaves water (empty cvar disables the sound)

cvars.name: sv_spectate
cvars.description: if set to 1, new clients are allowed to spectate or observe the game, if set to 0 joining clients spawn as players immediately (no spectating)

cvars.name: sv_spectator_speed_multiplier
cvars.description: base movement speed factor of spectators, all movement settings scale off this

cvars.name: sv_spectator_speed_multiplier_max
cvars.description: maximum movement speed factor for spectators as determined by scrolling

cvars.name: sv_spectator_speed_multiplier_min
cvars.description: minimum movement speed factor for spectators as determined by scrolling

cvars.name: sv_status_privacy
cvars.description: do not show IP addresses in 'status' replies to clients

cvars.name: sv_status_show_qcstatus
cvars.description: show the 'qcstatus' field in status replies, not the 'frags' field. Turn this on if your mod uses this field, and the 'frags' field on the other hand has no meaningful value.

cvars.name: sv_stepheight
cvars.description: how high you can step up (TW_SV_STEPCONTROL extension)

cvars.name: sv_stopspeed
cvars.description: how fast you come to a complete stop

cvars.name: sv_strengthsound_antispam_refire_threshold
cvars.description: apply minimum distance only if refire of the gun is smaller than this

cvars.name: sv_teamnagger
cvars.description: enable a nag message when the teams are unbalanced

cvars.name: sv_termsofservice_url
cvars.description: URL from which Server specific Terms of Service should be downloaded

cvars.name: sv_threaded
cvars.description: enables a separate thread for server code, improving performance, especially when hosting a game while playing, EXPERIMENTAL, may be crashy

cvars.name: sv_timeout
cvars.description: allow a player to call a timeout, this will pause the game for some time

cvars.name: sv_timeout_leadtime
cvars.description: how long the players will be informed that a timeout was called before it starts, in seconds

cvars.name: sv_timeout_length
cvars.description: how long the game will be paused at max, in seconds

cvars.name: sv_timeout_number
cvars.description: how many timeouts one player is allowed to call (gets reset after a restart)

cvars.name: sv_timeout_resumetime
cvars.description: how long the remaining timeout-time will be after a player called the timein command

cvars.name: sv_track_canjump
cvars.description: track if the player released the jump key between 2 jumps to decide if they are able to jump or not

cvars.name: sv_vote_call
cvars.description: Allow users to call a vote for the commands in sv_vote_commands

cvars.name: sv_vote_change
cvars.description: Allow voters to change their mind after already voting

cvars.name: sv_vote_command_help_gotomap
cvars.default:
Usage:^3 vcall gotomap mapname
^7  Where 'mapname' is the name of the map to go to.
  Type ^3lsmaps^7 to get a list of available maps to vote for.

cvars.name: sv_vote_commands
cvars.default: restart fraglimit gotomap nextmap endmatch reducematchtime extendmatchtime allready resetmatch kick cointoss movetoauto shuffleteams bots nobots
cvars.description: these commands can be voted by players or used directly by masters (vdo) in addition to sv_vote_master_commands

cvars.name: sv_vote_debug
cvars.description: count votes by bots too for debugging purposes (to get a bot to vote exec this command: bot_cmd 1 cc vote yes)

cvars.name: sv_vote_gametype
cvars.description: show a vote screen for gametypes before map vote screen

cvars.name: sv_vote_gametype_default_current
cvars.description: Keep the current gametype if no one votes

cvars.name: sv_vote_gametype_keeptwotime
cvars.description: show only 2 options after this amount of time during gametype vote screen

cvars.name: sv_vote_gametype_options
cvars.description: identifiers of gamemodes on the voting screen, can be custom (max 9 chars) - see example in server/server.cfg

cvars.name: sv_vote_gametype_timeout
cvars.description: how long the gametype vote screen lasts

cvars.name: sv_vote_limit
cvars.description: Maximum allowed length of a vote command

cvars.name: sv_vote_majority_factor
cvars.description: What percentage of the PLAYERS constitute a majority? (Must be at least 0.5, recommended: 0.5)

cvars.name: sv_vote_majority_factor_of_voted
cvars.description: What percentage of the VOTERS constitute a majority too? (Must be at least 0.5, recommended: 0.5)

cvars.name: sv_vote_master
cvars.description: Allows the use of the vote master system

cvars.name: sv_vote_master_callable
cvars.description: When set, users can use "vmaster" to call a vote to become master of voting commands

cvars.name: sv_vote_master_commands
cvars.description: Extra commands which vote masters can execute by themselves, along with the normal sv_vote_commands.

cvars.name: sv_vote_master_password
cvars.description: when set, users can use "vlogin PASSWORD" to log in as master, then run master commands directly using vdo

cvars.name: sv_vote_master_playerlimit
cvars.description: Minimum number of players needed for a player to be allowed to vote for master

cvars.name: sv_vote_no_stops_vote
cvars.description: Allow the vote caller to stop their own vote simply by voting no

cvars.name: sv_vote_nospectators
cvars.description: only players can call a vote (thus spectators and observers can't call a vote): 0 = all people can vote, 1 = spectators can vote in warmup stage, 2 = only players can vote (no exceptions).

cvars.name: sv_vote_singlecount
cvars.description: set to 1 to count votes once after timeout or to 0 to count with every vote

cvars.name: sv_vote_stop
cvars.description: a player can not call a vote again for this many seconds when they stopped this vote (e.g. to correct it)

cvars.name: sv_vote_timeout
cvars.description: a vote will timeout after this many seconds

cvars.name: sv_vote_wait
cvars.description: a player can not call a vote again for this many seconds when their vote was not accepted

cvars.name: sv_wallfriction
cvars.description: how much you slow down when sliding along a wall

cvars.name: sv_warsowbunny_accel
cvars.description: how fast you accelerate until after reaching sv_maxspeed (it gets harder as you near sv_warsowbunny_topspeed)

cvars.name: sv_warsowbunny_airforwardaccel
cvars.description: how fast you accelerate until you reach sv_maxspeed

cvars.name: sv_warsowbunny_backtosideratio
cvars.description: lower values make it easier to change direction without losing speed; the drawback is "understeering" in sharp turns

cvars.name: sv_warsowbunny_topspeed
cvars.description: soft speed limit (can get faster with rjs and on ramps)

cvars.name: sv_warsowbunny_turnaccel
cvars.description: max sharpness of turns (also master switch for the sv_warsowbunny_* mode; set this to 9 to enable)

cvars.name: sv_wateraccelerate
cvars.description: rate at which a player accelerates to sv_maxspeed while in the air, if less than 0 the sv_accelerate variable is used instead

cvars.name: sv_waterfriction
cvars.description: how fast you slow down, if less than 0 the sv_friction variable is used instead

cvars.name: sv_waypointsprite_deadlifetime
cvars.description: fade out lifetime of waypoints being removed

cvars.name: sv_waypointsprite_limitedrange
cvars.description: default maximum viewing distance of waypoints (if set by the waypoint)

cvars.name: sv_weaponstats_file
cvars.description: when set to a file name, per-weapon stats get written to that file

cvars.name: sv_worldbasename
cvars.description: name of current worldmodel without maps/ prefix or extension

cvars.name: sv_worldnamenoextension
cvars.description: name of current worldmodel without extension

cvars.name: sv_writepicture_quality
cvars.description: WritePicture quality offset (higher means better quality, but slower)

cvars.name: sys_colortranslation
cvars.description: terminal console color translation (supported values: 0 = strip color codes, 1 = translate to ANSI codes, 2 = no translation)

cvars.name: sys_debugsleep
cvars.description: write requested and attained sleep times to standard output, to be used with gnuplot

cvars.name: sys_memsize_physical
cvars.description: physical memory size in MB (or empty if unknown)

cvars.name: sys_memsize_virtual
cvars.description: virtual memory size in MB (or empty if unknown)

cvars.name: sys_specialcharactertranslation
cvars.description: terminal console conchars to ASCII translation (set to 0 if your conchars.tga is for an 8bit character set or if you want raw output)

cvars.name: sys_ticrate
cvars.description: how long a server frame is in seconds, 0.05 is 20fps server rate, 0.1 is 10fps (can not be set higher than 0.1), 0 runs as many server frames as possible (makes games against bots a little smoother, overwhelms network players), 0.0138889 matches QuakeWorld physics

cvars.name: sys_useclockgettime
cvars.description: use POSIX clock_gettime function (not adjusted by NTP on some older Linux kernels) for timing rather than gettimeofday (which has issues if the system time is stepped by ntpdate, or apparently on some Xen installations)

cvars.name: sys_usenoclockbutbenchmark
cvars.description: don't use ANY real timing, and simulate a clock (for benchmarking); the game then runs as fast as possible. Run a QC mod with bots that does some stuff, then does a quit at the end, to benchmark a server. NEVER do this on a public server.

cvars.name: team
cvars.description: QW team (4 character limit, example: blue)

cvars.name: teamplay
cvars.description: teamplay mode, values depend on mod but typically 0 = no teams, 1 = no team damage no self damage, 2 = team damage and self damage, some mods support 3 = no team damage but can damage self

cvars.name: teamplay_lockonrestart
cvars.description: lock teams once all players readied up and the game restarted (no new players can join after restart unless using the server-command unlockteams)

cvars.name: teamplay_mode
cvars.description: default teamplay setting in team games. 1 = no friendly fire, self damage. 2 = friendly fire and self damage enabled. 3 = no friendly fire, but self damage enabled. 4 = obey the cvars g_mirrordamage*, g_friendlyfire* and g_teamdamage*

cvars.name: temp1
cvars.description: general cvar for mods to use, in stock id1 this selects which death animation to use on players (0 = random death, other values select specific death scenes)

cvars.name: timeformat
cvars.description: time format to use on timestamped console messages

cvars.name: timelimit
cvars.description: ends level at this time (in minutes)

cvars.name: timelimit_decrement
cvars.description: number of minutes removed from the timer when voting for reducematchtime

cvars.name: timelimit_increment
cvars.description: number of minutes added to the timer when voting for extendmatchtime

cvars.name: timelimit_max
cvars.description: maximum match time achieveable with extendmatchtime and timelimit votes

cvars.name: timelimit_min
cvars.description: shortest match time achieveable with reducematchtime and timelimit votes

cvars.name: timelimit_override
cvars.description: Time limit overriding the mapinfo specified one (use 0 to play without limit, and -1 to use the mapinfo's limit)

cvars.name: timelimit_overtime
cvars.description: duration in minutes of one added overtime, added to the timelimit

cvars.name: timelimit_overtimes
cvars.description: how many overtimes to add at max

cvars.name: timelimit_suddendeath
cvars.description: number of minutes suddendeath mode lasts after all overtimes were added and still no winner was found

cvars.name: userbind14_press
cvars.default: say_team dropped weapon %w^7 (l:%l^7); g_waypointsprite_team_here; wait; dropweapon

cvars.name: userbind18_press
cvars.default: say hi / good luck and have fun

cvars.name: userbind6_press
cvars.default: say_team need help (l:%l^7) (h:%h^7 a:%a^7 w:%w^7); g_waypointsprite_team_helpme; cmd voice needhelp

cvars.name: userbind7_press
cvars.default: say_team enemy seen (l:%y^7); g_waypointsprite_team_danger_p; cmd voice incoming

cvars.name: userbind8_press
cvars.default: say_team flag seen (l:%y^7); g_waypointsprite_team_here_p; cmd voice seenflag

cvars.name: utf8_enable
cvars.description: Enable UTF-8 support. For compatibility, this is disabled by default in most games.

cvars.name: v_centermove
cvars.description: how long before the view begins to center itself (if freelook/+mlook/+jlook/+klook are off)

cvars.name: v_centerspeed
cvars.description: how fast the view centers itself

cvars.name: v_deathtilt
cvars.description: whether to use sideways view when dead

cvars.name: v_deathtiltangle
cvars.description: what roll angle to use when tilting the view while dead

cvars.name: v_idlescale
cvars.description: how much of the quake 'drunken view' effect to use

cvars.name: v_kickpitch
cvars.description: how much a view kick from damage pitches your view

cvars.name: v_kickroll
cvars.description: how much a view kick from damage rolls your view

cvars.name: v_kicktime
cvars.description: how long a view kick from damage lasts

cvars.name: v_yshearing
cvars.description: be all out of gum (set this to the maximum angle to allow Y shearing for - try values like 75)

cvars.name: vid_x11_display
cvars.description: xonotic-linux-*.sh will use this to start xonotic on an other/new X display

cvars.name: waypoint_benchmark
cvars.description: quit after waypoint loading to benchmark bot navigation code
